items.content: Google has released its latest frontier model, Gemini 4 Carbon, offering “significant gains” in coding, agentic tasks, and cybersecurity. In an announcement on Wednesday, Google highlights Carbon’s top spot on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (v5.0) benchmark, with Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra trailing behind.The new Gemini 4 Carbon model offers improvements over Argon, which Google released earlier this month. It’s currently only available to a select group of cybersecurity defense companies, but it will eventually expand to other partners in its Fairwind Program.Carbon sits ahead of Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra. Image: Artificial Analysis Intelligence IndexThe company says Carbon reflects the “pace at which we’re pushing the frontier forward,” coming with a “significant leap” in cyberdefense that makes it better at finding vulnerabilities and generating secure code. Carbon currently holds the number one spot on SEC-bench Pro, a benchmark that measures an AI model’s ability to discover real-world bugs, and ExploitGym, which measures how a model can turn a vulnerability into exploits.Gemini 4 Carbon also beat GPT-6 Astra on the SEC-bench Pro cybersecurity benchmark. Image: GoogleGoogle says Gemini 4 Carbon is built for completing longer tasks, adding that its internal teams have seen it “run for days to persist through dead ends to tackle complex, multi-step engineering tasks.” It’s also better at avoiding shortcuts, resisting prompt injection attacks, and collaborating with users, according to Google. Carbon is supposed to offer more “transparency and honesty” as well, by cutting “unsupported claims” by two times when compared to Argon.It will launch at the same competitive introductory price as Argon, at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens.

items.titleZh: 谷歌推出Gemini 4 Carbon，网络安全实现“重大飞跃”
items.descriptionZh:
Google 发布了最新前沿模型 Gemini 4 Carbon，称其在编程、代理型任务和网络安全方面取得“显著提升”。谷歌在周三的公告中强调，Gemini 4 Carbon 在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index（v5.0）基准上排名第一，Claude Opus 5.5 和 GPT-6 Astra 位列其后。该模型相较谷歌本月初发布的 Argon 有所改进。目前 Gemini 4 Carbon 仅向部分网络安全防御公司开放，未来将逐步扩展至 Fairwind Program 中的其他合作伙伴。

谷歌表示，Carbon 体现了公司“推进前沿的速度”，并在网络防御能力上实现“显著跃升”，使其更擅长发现漏洞和生成安全代码。Carbon 目前在 SEC-bench Pro 和 ExploitGym 两项基准上均排名第一：前者衡量 AI 模型发现真实世界漏洞的能力，后者衡量模型将漏洞转化为利用方式的能力。谷歌还称，Gemini 4 Carbon 在 SEC-bench Pro 网络安全基准上击败了 GPT-6 Astra。

在技术能力上，谷歌称 Carbon 专为完成更长任务而构建，内部团队已看到它“连续运行数天，在遇到死胡同后仍能坚持推进，以处理复杂、多步骤的工程任务”。它还被描述为更擅长避免走捷径、抵御提示注入攻击以及与用户协作。谷歌表示，Carbon 还旨在提供更高的“透明度和诚实度”，与 Argon 相比将“无依据声明”减少两倍。

定价方面，Gemini 4 Carbon 将采用与 Argon 相同的竞争性 introductory price：每百万输入 token 2 美元，每百万输出 token 10 美元。整体来看，Carbon 的发布显示出前沿模型竞争正从通用能力进一步延伸到长时程代理任务、安全代码生成和网络安全攻防基准；其当前受限开放策略也表明，谷歌希望先在网络安全防御场景中验证高风险能力，再扩大合作伙伴范围。原文未披露具体模型架构，因此其创新主要体现在长任务持久性、抗提示注入、减少无依据输出以及网络安全基准表现上。

items.title: Malaysia seizes $12 million worth of advanced AI chips hidden inside 30 servers
items.description: Malaysian customs seized 30 servers containing more than $12 million worth of advanced AI chips at Kuala Lumpur International Airport, as authorities investigate a suspected smuggling network linked to multiple previous seizures.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Malaysian customs have seized over $12 million (49.5 million Malaysian ringgit) worth of advanced AI chips in a single bust, as the country clamps down on a suspected semiconductor smuggling syndicate. According to a Reuters report on October 28, officials found 30 servers containing the chips at Kuala Lumpur International Airport’s free trade zone on October 15th. Initial investigations revealed that the shipment originated in an Asian country and was bound for another undisclosed Asian country.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)The data center cooling state of playThe custom AI ASIC state of play America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the priceGTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this yearDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsibleThe airport’s customs director, Aspalila Ag Tuah, confirmed that the servers were falsely declared as ordinary electronic goods, saying the suspected scheme used Malaysia as a transit point to avoid restrictions on the goods’ onward movement. The Malaysian company involved in the shipment has been summoned to assist in the investigation.Authorities suspect that the foiled smuggling attempt was carried out by the same group responsible for a similar attempt last June. On June 5, customs officers discovered 72 server units containing advanced AI chips at the Kuala Lumpur International Airport, valued at approximately $13 million. This shipment had also been falsely declared as computer components and was meant to be reshipped without the required permit. Aspalila said the network has been linked to seizures worth over $25 million so far across at least five cases. She declined to provide further information on the network or the current case, citing ongoing investigations.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Several key facts remain unknown, including the chip type, country of manufacture, final destination, and intended recipient — whether a company or a military organization. The U.S. had placed export controls on the movement of advanced Nvidia and other U.S.-origin AI chips to China, the most likely destination for the seized chips. Smuggling networks began using Malaysia, a U.S. ally not affected by the controls, as a hub, exporting the banned chips to the country before re-exporting them to China.While the country’s geographic location and mature logistics infrastructure make it important for legitimate international trade, these characteristics also make it ideal for smuggling sensitive technology. To restrict this avenue, Malaysia subsequently imposed export controls on the ​movement of advanced AI chips of U.S. origin, at Washington’s request. Other Asian U.S. allies, such as Singapore and Taiwan, have implemented similar controls. Demand for powerful Nvidia GPUs remains high in China, fueling a booming market for smuggled hardware. items.titleZh: 马来西亚查获藏在30台服务器内的价值1200万美元先进AI芯片
items.descriptionZh:
马来西亚海关近日在吉隆坡国际机场自由贸易区查获一批价值超过1200万美元（4950万马来西亚林吉特）的先进AI芯片，这是该国打击疑似半导体走私网络的一次重大行动。据路透社10月28日报道，海关官员于10月15日发现30台装有先进AI芯片的服务器。初步调查显示，这批货物源自某个亚洲国家，目的地是另一个未披露的亚洲国家。吉隆坡国际机场海关关长阿斯帕利拉·阿格·图阿证实，涉事服务器被虚假申报为普通电子产品，疑似走私方案利用马来西亚作为中转站，以规避相关货物继续转运所受的限制。涉案马来西亚公司已被传唤协助调查。

当局怀疑，此次被挫败的走私企图与今年6月一起类似案件由同一团伙实施。6月5日，海关官员曾在吉隆坡国际机场发现72台装有先进AI芯片的服务器，价值约1300万美元。该批货物同样被虚假申报为计算机组件，并计划在未取得所需许可的情况下再出口。阿斯帕利拉表示，该网络目前至少与5起案件相关，涉案查获总值已超过2500万美元。由于调查仍在进行，她拒绝透露该网络或当前案件的更多信息。

目前仍有若干关键事实不明，包括芯片类型、制造国、最终目的地以及预期收货方——无论是企业还是军事组织。美国已对先进英伟达及其他美国原产AI芯片的对华流动实施出口管制，而中国被认为是这些被查获芯片最可能的目的地。走私网络开始利用马来西亚作为枢纽：马来西亚是美国盟友，不受上述管制影响，走私者先将受禁芯片出口至马来西亚，再转运至中国。马来西亚的地理位置和成熟物流基础设施使其对合法国际贸易十分重要，但同样使其成为走私敏感技术的理想中转地。为限制这一渠道，马来西亚随后应华盛顿要求，对美国原产先进AI芯片的流动实施出口管制。新加坡和台湾等其他亚洲美国盟友也实施了类似管制。中国对强大英伟达GPU的需求仍然旺盛，推动了走私硬件的繁荣市场。

从技术层面看，原文所称“先进AI芯片”通常指用于数据中心AI训练和推理的GPU或AI加速器，其核心能力在于并行计算，可加速矩阵运算等深度学习工作负载，因而成为大模型训练、推理、高性能计算和云数据中心的关键硬件。此类芯片受出口管制，主要因其高算力可用于人工智能、超级计算及潜在军事用途。不过，原文并未披露被查获芯片的具体型号、算力、显存带宽、互连能力或能效等性能参数，也未提供不同芯片之间的对比数据，因此无法就此次查获硬件的具体性能作出量化分析。案件目前更多体现出口管制执行、转口贸易合规和跨国走私网络问题，而非某一新款芯片的技术创新。

该事件的影响主要体现在三方面：一是显示美国对华AI芯片出口管制正推动走私网络利用第三国中转，促使马来西亚、新加坡和台湾等美国盟友加强协同管制；二是对马来西亚的转口贸易、自由贸易区监管和企业合规提出更高要求，涉事公司可能面临调查和法律责任；三是凸显中国市场对高端英伟达GPU的强劲需求，以及算力获取受限背景下地下硬件市场的持续活跃。应用场景方面，此类芯片主要面向AI模型训练与推理、数据中心加速、科学计算等；一旦非法流转，可能影响受控技术的最终用途和供应链安全。总体而言，此案是AI芯片出口管制收紧后，围绕第三国转运、虚假申报和走私网络展开的最新执法案例，但被查获芯片的具体技术规格和最终流向仍有待调查披露。

items.content: Following improvements made to Chrome’s enhanced autofill last year that included your name, passport number, email address, and physical addresses sourced from your Google Accounts and services like Google Wallet, the feature is now expanding. Starting today, Chrome’s enhanced autofill will use Gemini with Personal Intelligence to suggest information sourced from your Gmail, potentially saving you from having to search for confirmation emails, receipts, or shipping updates yourself.The expanded autofill capabilities can retrieve details such as a shipment’s tracking number, travel details like a flight booking number or hotel reservation, or the order number of a recent purchase. Sensitive data presented as a suggestion while completing a form remains encrypted, and users can manage what enhanced autofill has access to in Chrome’s settings, or turn it off completely.Chrome can suggest details automatically pulled from your Gmail account so you can complete forms without constantly hopping between browser tabs. Image: GoogleGoogle is starting to roll out the enhanced autofill improvements today in the US. They’ll be available through Gemini in Chrome for users with Personal Intelligence turned on in the desktop, Android, and iOS versions of the browser.

items.titleZh: Chrome增强版自动填充现可从Gmail获取信息，助你填写表单
items.descriptionZh:
Chrome的增强自动填充功能再次扩展。此前，该功能已能基于Google账户以及Google Wallet等服务，自动填充姓名、护照号码、电子邮件地址和物理地址等信息；现在，Chrome将引入Gemini的Personal Intelligence能力，从用户的Gmail中提取信息并生成填充建议，帮助用户免去手动搜索确认邮件、收据或物流更新邮件的麻烦。可检索的信息包括物流跟踪号、航班预订号、酒店预订信息以及近期购买的订单号等。用户在填写表单时看到的敏感数据建议仍保持加密；用户可在Chrome设置中管理增强自动填充的访问范围，或完全关闭该功能。

从技术原理看，这一功能将Gemini的个人智能能力与浏览器表单填写场景结合：系统在获得用户授权后，从Gmail邮件中识别并提取结构化字段，再结合当前网页表单的输入需求生成自动填充建议。其创新点在于，自动填充的数据来源从相对静态的个人资料和账户信息，扩展到Gmail中的动态业务信息，使浏览器能在不频繁切换标签页、不手动查找邮件的情况下完成表单填写。安全与权限控制方面，敏感建议数据保持加密，并提供设置项供用户管理或关闭功能。

原文未披露准确率、响应延迟、支持表单类型数量等量化性能指标，因此暂无具体性能参数可比。与上一代增强自动填充相比，主要变化是新增Gmail作为建议来源，并将可填充内容从身份和地址信息扩展到物流、旅行和订单等邮件上下文信息。该功能将率先在美国逐步推出，面向在桌面端、Android和iOS版Chrome中开启Personal Intelligence的用户，通过Chrome中的Gemini提供。其应用场景主要包括电商物流查询、订单号填写、航班和酒店预订信息录入等。该扩展有望减少用户在邮件与网页表单之间复制粘贴和切换标签页的操作，提高表单填写效率；但同时，由于涉及Gmail个人数据，隐私授权、数据加密和用户可控性将成为该功能落地的重要前提。

items.title: Amazon tells engineers to stop ‘tokenmaxxing’ to look productive
items.description: Amazon has published new engineering guidelines warning developers and managers against ‘tokenmaxxing,’ arguing that AI usage metrics are ‘deeply flawed’ unless tied to long-term outcomes. The move follows similar spending concerns at Uber and Accenture.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 5 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Amazon wants its engineers to quit chasing token counts, warning that heavy AI usage does not automatically mean better work. In updated engineering guidelines published on October 27, the company laid out how developers and managers should gauge AI’s real impact — and the takeaway is blunt: consuming more tokens is not the same as delivering more value. Amazon is not backing away from the technology, though. “We are certain that whatever future best practices are, AI will be at the center of software engineering practice,” the company wrote.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)The data center cooling state of playThe custom AI ASIC state of play America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the priceGTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this yearDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsibleThe guidance targets ‘tokenmaxxing,’ a practice where employees deliberately inflate their AI usage to look productive on internal dashboards. According to the memo, metrics such as AI adoption rates, token consumption, code changes, and code reviews become ‘deeply flawed’ when they are disconnected from actual results. Turning them into targets, Amazon says, encourages wasteful behavior that clashes with its emphasis on ‘frugality and simplicity’ and can raise both compute bills and software complexity.The company’s preferred yardstick is long-term results. “We believe that it is best to measure, and be measured by, long-term outcomes,” Amazon wrote. That does not mean managers should ignore usage data altogether, as input metrics remain useful when examined ‘with care and judgment’ alongside other indicators. Amazon suggests looking at both the teams using AI the least and those using it the most to determine whether adoption is translating into better delivery.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The push comes as Amazon, under CEO Andy Jassy, has been weaving AI deeply into its sprawling operations. Jassy said earlier this year that the technology will ‘change the scope and speed’ of everyday work, and he has suggested that automation could shrink the company’s corporate workforce over the next few years — though he also expects it to create ‘other jobs.’The memo also pushes back on the idea that every task needs an AI tool. If current tooling does not benefit someone’s work, Amazon says, that is ‘a finding, not a failing.’ Engineers who can explain where today’s tools fall short are demonstrating judgment rather than reluctance to adopt AI. You may like Amazon cracks down on 'CPU waste' among engineers to amid AI CPU crunch [Updated] Big Tech is cashing in on AI while the rest of corporate America sees no financial returns Software could be the easiest fix for hyperscalers' AI power squeeze, researchers say In May, it emerged that Amazon employees were using AI unnecessarily to boost internal usage scores, amid pressure to use the company's tools. Workers reportedly used MeshClaw, an internal AI agent capable of handling tasks such as deploying code and interacting with Slack, to inflate their token counts.Notably, Amazon is not the only company rethinking how it spends on AI. Uber president and COO Andrew Macdonald said in May that higher token usage has yet to translate into useful consumer features. “That link is not there yet,” he said. The remark stands out because Uber’s CTO previously revealed that the company had burned through its entire 2026 Claude Code budget by April.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsAccenture appears to also be wrestling with the same problem on behalf of its clients. Leaked audio obtained by 404 Media in June captures executives acknowledging that token spending is climbing fast as companies move from simple chatbots to agentic workflows, and that nobody can reliably predict what a given task will cost or whether it was worth the money. Accenture’s agentic AI strategy lead described it as ‘not a niche problem,’ and the firm is reportedly building an advisory tool called ‘Token IQ’ to help customers manage the bill. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has previously acknowledged that AI token costs had become 'a huge issue', as companies faced mounting bills from heavy AI use.Amazon, however, says it has not imposed token caps on its employees. According to CNBC, however, it shut down an internal leaderboard in May after workers were found gaming it to climb the rankings — an early example of the behavior the new guidelines are meant to discourage. items.titleZh: 亚马逊要求工程师停止“刷Token”以显得高效
items.descriptionZh:
亚马逊在10月27日更新的工程指南中明确警告员工：不要一味追求AI token使用量，消耗更多token并不等于创造更多价值。公司同时强调，这并不意味着亚马逊要远离AI；相反，亚马逊认为无论未来最佳实践如何演变，AI都将处于软件工程实践的中心。

这份指南主要针对“tokenmaxxing”现象，即员工为了在内部看板上显得更高效，刻意抬高自己的AI使用量。亚马逊指出，AI采用率、token消耗量、代码变更和代码审查等指标，一旦与实际结果脱节，就会变成“严重有缺陷”的指标；把这些指标当成目标，会鼓励浪费行为，与公司强调的“节俭和简洁”相冲突，还可能推高计算账单、增加软件复杂度。亚马逊更倾向以长期结果作为衡量标准，但也不主张完全忽视使用数据：输入指标在“谨慎判断”并与其他指标结合时仍有价值。公司建议同时观察AI使用最少和使用最多的团队，判断采用AI是否真正转化为更好的交付。

指南还反驳了“每项任务都需要AI工具”的想法。亚马逊表示，如果现有工具不能改善某人的工作，这是“一个发现，而不是失败”；工程师能够解释当前工具的不足，体现的是判断力，而不是不愿采用AI。背景是，亚马逊在CEO Andy Jassy带领下正把AI深度嵌入各项业务。Jassy今年早些时候称，这项技术将“改变日常工作的范围和速度”，并暗示未来几年自动化可能缩小公司企业员工规模，但也会创造“其他工作”。

今年5月有报道称，在要求使用公司工具的压力下，亚马逊员工曾不必要地使用AI来提高内部使用分数。员工据称使用内部AI智能体MeshClaw来抬高token计数，该工具可执行部署代码、与Slack交互等任务。值得注意的是，亚马逊并非唯一重新思考AI支出的公司。Uber总裁兼COO Andrew Macdonald今年5月表示，更高的token使用量尚未转化为有用的消费者功能，“这种联系还不存在”。Uber CTO此前还透露，公司在4月就用完了2026年全年的Claude Code预算。咨询公司埃森哲也面临类似问题。404 Media 6月获得的泄露音频显示，高管承认随着企业从简单聊天机器人转向智能体工作流，token支出快速上升，且没人能可靠预测某项任务的花费或是否值得。埃森哲的智能体AI战略负责人称这“不是一个小众问题”，公司据称正在构建名为“Token IQ”的咨询工具，帮助客户管理账单。OpenAI CEO Sam Altman此前也承认，AI token成本已成为“一个巨大问题”。

不过，亚马逊表示并未对员工设置token上限。据CNBC报道，亚马逊曾在5月关闭一个内部排行榜，因为发现员工通过刷量来提升排名——这正是新指南希望抑制的行为的一个早期案例。整体来看，亚马逊的新规反映出企业AI管理正从“采用率竞赛”转向“结果导向”，要求管理者在使用数据与长期产出之间做出更审慎的权衡。

items.title: Thin, Light and Built for Everything: NVIDIA RTX Spark Windows Laptops Gain New Models, Agent Tools and Games
items.description: NVIDIA RTX Spark powers thin and light laptops built for everything that developers, creators and gamers do. items.content: NVIDIA RTX Spark powers thin and light laptops built for everything that developers, creators and gamers do. RTX Spark laptops are now available from ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI. These powerful systems combine an NVIDIA Blackwell RTX GPU and an NVIDIA Grace CPU in a single superchip with up to 128GB of unified memory and up to 1 petaflop of FP4 AI performance. That puts the NVIDIA CUDA platform, RTX graphics and the capabilities of a personal AI supercomputer inside premium Windows laptops built to go anywhere. New and expected RTX Spark updates, coming soon, include: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an open weight speech model for transcription, speaker attribution and translation is available on RTX Spark. The LFM3 family of open models with day-zero support. Resource management controls in NVIDIA App to allocate GPU resources between foreground apps and background agents. Phantom Blade Zero, S-GAME’s highly-anticipated action role-playing game, launches with ray tracing and NVIDIA DLSS 4.5. Experience Minecraft with path tracing and DLSS with RTX Remix1.6, available now for RTX Spark. Turn Recorded Audio Into Useful Information With NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe Introduced today, NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe is a new, open weight speech model that turns recorded conversations into useful information. Instead of needing multiple models for transcription, speaker labels and translation, developers can use one promptable model that handles all three, plus questions about the audio. It transcribes 40 languages, including seven Indic languages. Developers guide the model with plain-language prompts. For example, for a single recorded meeting, users can ask it to: “Transcribe this recording and label each speaker.” “Translate this audio into English.” “List what decisions were made in this meeting.” Prompts can also include product terms and formatting conventions, which helps the model handle specialized vocabulary in fields like healthcare, financial services and customer service. Because the weights are open, developers can choose where audio is processed, from a desktop to the cloud. Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe ranks No. 1 on the Hugging Face Open ASR and No. 2 among open weight models on Artificial Analysis — delivering leading accuracy with approximately 4.3 billion active parameters, 80% fewer than the No. 1 open weight model, making high-quality, intelligent transcription more practical on local hardware. It’s available today on Hugging Face. Quantized versions are coming soon, so developers can run Transcribe locally onNVIDIA RTX Spark and DGX Spark systems, Jetson AGX Thor devices or scale up on NVIDIA Blackwell data center GPUs. NVFP4 versions will be deployable through NeMo-Speech.cpp or vLLM. Learn more in the NVIDIA technical blog. Control How Agents and PC Apps Share GPU Resources On RTX Spark, users can have long-running agents working alongside their favorite applications. Both share the system’s GPU compute, and the right balance of resources depends on what matters to users at that moment. With the new resource management feature in NVIDIA App, users can now choose how GPU resources are shared. They can prioritize their foreground app for the best performance, or give their background-running agent more resources to get work done faster. Access control resource sharing from System > Advanced in the NVIDIA App. This feature requires hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling to be enabled in Windows Settings. Liquid AI: One Model Family, Many Ways to Work Liquid AI’s LFM3 provides a new generation of Liquid Foundation Models designed for specialized tasks. The family spans text, vision, audio, omni and decision models built on one shared backbone, with base and post-trained models available as open weights. The models are compact and fast: Liquid AI’s new 1.7-billion-parameter base model outperforms its previous 2.6-billion-parameter base model. These models support local workflows such as agents running in Hermes Agent, Pi and OpenClaw to triage inboxes and manage calendars, read documents and app screens, transcribe and translate speech, answer spoken questions about handwritten math, and route support tickets or voice requests. Developers can run LFM3 models on RTX Spark with native support through llama.cpp and vLLM, and fine-tune the models locally. ‘Phantom Blade Zero’ Launches With DLSS 4.5 S-GAME’s Phantom Blade Zero launches tonight, Oct. 28, at 7 p.m. PT on Steam and the Epic Games Store. Players can take on the role of Soul, a swordsman framed for his master’s murder, as he travels the martial world to uncover a conspiracy. NVIDIA worked with S-GAME Studio and S-GAME Publishing to add ray-traced effects to the title. On RTX Spark laptops and GeForce RTX GPU-powered PCs, ray tracing adds more accurate bounced lighting, detailed reflections and realistic shadows on foliage and terrain. The NVIDIA DLSS Dynamic Multi Frame Generation feature boosts frame rates with up to 6x frame generation, or adjusts the multiplier on the fly to hit a player’s target frame rate. Read more on GeForce.com. RTX Remix Breathes New Life Into Classics NVIDIA RTX Remix, the modding platform for remastering classic games with path tracing and DLSS, released version 1.6 last week. This update brought RTX Remix to the world’s largest gaming community: Minecraft. Both creators and players can render Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.1 through RTX Remix with DLSS-accelerated path tracing and take full advantage of realistic lighting and materials in their future creations. The update also adds DLSS 5 with 3D-Guided Neural Rendering, up to 6x Multi Frame Generation, native RTX Spark support and agent-assisted workflows. Starting today, those upgrades come to Portal with RTX and the Half-Life 2 RTX demo. Both now support RTX Spark, with DLSS 3D-Guided Neural Rendering for more lifelike lighting and materials, a new Performance Mode for DLSS Frame Generation and new options that speed up path tracing. RTX Remix 1.6 also makes AI-powered modding simpler. A redesigned ComfyUI workflow lets modders generate physically based materials directly inside RTX Remix, with no application programming interface setup, batch processing for full projects and presets for less technical creators. Plus, with NVIDIA agent skills, compatible AI agents can work directly with RTX Remix to help speed up remastering projects. Learn more in the RTX Remix blog. RTX Spark Laptops: Beautifully Designed, Built for Everything RTX Spark laptops come in a range of designs, so users can choose one that fits how they work and play. Options include different screen sizes, colors, touchscreens, pen support and two-in-one convertibles. RTX Spark laptops are as thin as 14mm and as light as three pounds, with all-day battery life. Such slim designs are possible because RTX Spark places the GPU, CPU and up to 128GB of unified memory on one power-efficient superchip. Creative projects and AI models draw from the same memory pool, so a laptop can take on work that used to call for a desktop workstation, even when unplugged. Here’s what this means for: AI developers: Run models and agents locally on NVIDIA CUDA — the same platform that powers AI in the cloud — with a path to deploy across more than 150 million NVIDIA RTX AI PCs and NVIDIA GPUs in the cloud. Creators: RTX Spark can edit camera native 4:2:2 video and render 3D scenes of up to 90GB. Adobe Photoshop and Premiere offer native RTX Spark support through beta releases. Gamers: Hundreds of games run on RTX Spark, with NVIDIA DLSS, ray tracing, Reflex and G-SYNC delivering sharper visuals and smoother, more responsive gameplay. RTX Spark laptops are available now from ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI, starting at $2,599, with 128GB configurations on shelves. Find a laptop on the RTX Spark product page. #ICYMI: More Updates From NVIDIA Local AI 🦆Microducks learn to walk with help from RTX Spark: During the GTC Berlin keynote, NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang showed how AI agents running on RTX Spark can help train Hugging Face’s Microduck robot. A new NVIDIA technical blog walks through the workflow: Hermes Agent and Nemotron 3.5 Bolt plan an obstacle course on RTX Spark, Astra builds the 3D assets, NVIDIA Isaac Lab trains the navigation policy and RTX Spark validates it in NVIDIA Isaac Sim. Watch the demo and try the playbook. ⚡NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB is now available, enabling natural conversations and multistep agent tasks with as little as 4GB of memory. The model powers local voice assistants, game characters and embedded interfaces on RTX Spark, DGX Spark, GeForce RTX GPUs and NVIDIA Jetson devices. It supports llama.cpp, vLLM, Ollama, Unsloth and LM Studio, and works with Hermes and OpenClaw. For more demanding agent workloads, Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB is designed to run local agents on RTX Spark. 🖼️Black Forest Labs’ FLUX 3 Image Klein is a 5.6-billion-parameter open weights model that lets users generate and edit images locally. NVIDIA-optimized versions run on RTX GPUs with as little as 8GB of VRAM. Developers can also fine-tune the model on RTX Spark using an NVIDIA NeMo AutoModel recipe to customize it for specific creative workflows. 🖥️NVIDIA DGX Spark 64GB is now available to purchase from manufacturer partners, giving developers and researchers another way to build and run AI locally. Powered by the GB10 Grace Blackwell Superchip, it combines 64GB of unified memory with DGX OS and the NVIDIA AI software stack for agent development, inference and fine-tuning. Learn more and explore purchase options. Follow NVIDIA RTX Spark on X, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook — and stay informed by subscribing to the NVIDIA Local AI newsletter. Follow NVIDIA Workstation on LinkedIn and X. See notice regarding software product information.

items.titleZh: 轻薄全能：NVIDIA RTX Spark Windows笔记本电脑新增多款机型、智能体工具及游戏
items.descriptionZh:
英伟达宣布，RTX Spark 笔记本电脑已由华硕、戴尔、惠普、联想、微软和微星推出。该产品面向开发者、创作者和游戏玩家，定位为轻薄高性能 Windows 笔记本，核心是将 Blackwell 架构 RTX GPU 与 Grace CPU 集成在单一超级芯片中，最高配备 128GB 统一内存和最高 1 PFLOPS FP4 AI 性能，从而把 CUDA 平台、RTX 图形能力和“个人 AI 超级计算机”能力装进便携设备。RTX Spark 笔记本起售价 2599 美元，128GB 配置已上架。

**产品形态与技术架构**

RTX Spark 的关键创新在于“超级芯片 + 统一内存”架构。GPU、CPU 和最高 128GB 内存共享同一内存池，减少传统 PC 中 CPU 内存与 GPU 显存之间的数据搬运和容量分割。这意味着笔记本可以本地运行更大 AI 模型、渲染最高 90GB 的 3D 场景，并编辑相机原生 4:2:2 视频。高能效单芯片设计使产品最薄约 14mm、最轻约 3 磅（约 1.36kg），具备全天电池续航，并提供不同屏幕尺寸、颜色、触控、手写笔和二合一形态。

对开发者而言，RTX Spark 运行 NVIDIA CUDA 平台，与云端 AI 平台同源，可把本地开发成果扩展到超过 1.5 亿台 RTX AI PC 和云端 NVIDIA GPU。对创作者而言，Adobe Photoshop 和 Premiere 已通过 beta 版本提供原生 RTX Spark 支持。对游戏玩家而言，数百款游戏可在 RTX Spark 上运行，并支持 DLSS、光线追踪、Reflex 和 G-SYNC。

**AI 软件与模型更新**

英伟达同步公布多项 RTX Spark 软件与模型生态更新，部分已可用、部分即将推出。

NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe 是一款新的开放权重语音模型，可用一个可提示模型完成转写、说话人标注和翻译，并支持针对音频内容提问。它支持 40 种语言，包括 7 种印度语言；开发者可用自然语言提示引导模型，例如“转写这段录音并标注每位说话人”“把这段音频翻译成英文”“列出会议中做出的决定”。提示中还可加入产品术语和格式规范，以适配医疗、金融服务、客户服务等专业词汇。由于权重开放，开发者可自行选择在桌面端或云端处理音频。该模型在 Hugging Face 开放 ASR 榜单排名第一，在 Artificial Analysis 开放权重模型榜单排名第二；活跃参数约 43 亿，比排名第一的开放权重模型少约 80%，以更少参数实现领先准确率，使高质量智能转写更适合本地硬件运行。它已在 Hugging Face 发布，量化版本即将推出，可在 RTX Spark、DGX Spark、Jetson AGX Thor 上本地运行，也可在 Blackwell 数据中心 GPU 上扩展；NVFP4 版本可通过 NeMo-Speech.cpp 或 vLLM 部署。

NVIDIA App 新增资源管理功能，允许用户在 RTX Spark 上分配 GPU 资源：可优先保障前台应用性能，也可给后台运行的智能体更多资源以更快完成任务。该功能位于 NVIDIA App 的 System > Advanced，需在 Windows 设置中启用硬件加速 GPU 调度。

Liquid AI 的 LFM3 开放模型家族获得首日支持。该家族基于共享骨干覆盖文本、视觉、音频、全模态和决策模型，基础模型与后训练模型以开放权重提供。其 17 亿参数基础模型性能超过上一代 26 亿参数基础模型，支持本地智能体工作流，例如在 Hermes Agent、Pi 和 OpenClaw 中分拣收件箱、管理日历、读取文档和应用屏幕、转写和翻译语音、回答关于手写数学的口头问题，以及路由支持工单或语音请求。开发者可通过 llama.cpp 和 vLLM 在 RTX Spark 上原生运行 LFM3，并在本地微调。

**游戏与 RTX Remix**

S-GAME 的《影之刃零》于 10 月 28 日晚 7 点（太平洋时间）登陆 Steam 和 Epic Games Store。玩家扮演被诬陷杀害师父的剑客“魂”，在武侠世界中揭开阴谋。NVIDIA 与 S-GAME 工作室及发行团队合作，为游戏加入光线追踪效果，带来更准确的反弹光照、细致反射以及植被和地形上的真实阴影。DLSS 动态多帧生成最高支持 6 倍帧生成，并可动态调整倍率以命中玩家目标帧率。

RTX Remix 1.6 上周发布，把这一用于经典游戏重制的模改平台带到《我的世界》。创作者和玩家可通过 RTX Remix 渲染《我的世界》Java 版 1.21.1，并使用 DLSS 加速的路径追踪，获得真实光照和材质。该更新还加入 DLSS 5 与 3D 引导神经渲染、最高 6 倍多帧生成、原生 RTX Spark 支持以及智能体辅助工作流。即日起，《Portal with RTX》和《半衰期 2 RTX》演示也获得这些升级，二者均支持 RTX Spark，并加入 DLSS 3D 引导神经渲染、用于 DLSS 帧生成的性能模式以及加速路径追踪的新选项。RTX Remix 1.6 还简化 AI 模改：重新设计的 ComfyUI 工作流让模改者直接在 RTX Remix 内生成基于物理的材质，无需配置 API，支持完整项目批处理和面向非技术创作者的预设；兼容的 AI 智能体还可通过 NVIDIA 智能体技能直接与 RTX Remix 协作，加速重制项目。

**其他本地 AI 生态更新**

在 GTC 柏林主题演讲中，英伟达创始人兼 CEO 黄仁勋展示了 RTX Spark 上运行的 AI 智能体如何帮助训练 Hugging Face 的 Microduck 机器人。工作流包括：Hermes Agent 和 Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 在 RTX Spark 上规划障碍路线，Astra 构建 3D 资产，NVIDIA Isaac Lab 训练导航策略，RTX Spark 在 Isaac Sim 中验证。

Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB 现已可用，仅需 4GB 内存即可支持自然对话和多步智能体任务，可在 RTX Spark、DGX Spark、GeForce RTX GPU 和 NVIDIA Jetson 设备上驱动本地语音助手、游戏角色和嵌入式界面；支持 llama.cpp、vLLM、Ollama、Unsloth 和 LM Studio，并可与 Hermes、OpenClaw 配合。面向更高要求的智能体负载，Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB 设计用于在 RTX Spark 上运行本地智能体。

Black Forest Labs 的 FLUX 3 Image Klein 是 56 亿参数开放权重模型，支持本地生成和编辑图像。NVIDIA 优化版本可在最低 8GB 显存的 RTX GPU 上运行；开发者还可用 NVIDIA NeMo AutoModel 配方在 RTX Spark 上微调，以适配特定创作流程。

NVIDIA DGX Spark 64GB 现已可从制造商伙伴购买，搭载 GB10 Grace Blackwell 超级芯片，结合 64GB 统一内存、DGX OS 和 NVIDIA AI 软件栈，用于智能体开发、推理和微调。

整体来看，RTX Spark 把原本依赖桌面工作站或云端的高性能 AI 与图形工作负载进一步推向轻薄笔记本。统一内存和 CUDA 生态是其核心差异点，开放权重模型和本地智能体功能则强化了隐私、低延迟和离线可用性。其 2599 美元起售价和 128GB 配置表明，该产品首先面向高端专业用户和重度创作者、开发者及玩家，而非大众入门市场。

items.content: A subsidiary of Elon Musk’s xAI is offering to buy up homes in a Mississippi neighborhood, as long as residents don’t join a lawsuit targeting the company’s nearby data center and power plant, according to a report from The Guardian. A realtor going door-to-door in the Southaven neighborhood reportedly told one resident that xAI plans to purchase 418 homes, adding that 18 homeowners already have plans to sell. People who rent homes in the area report they’re already being forced out, with 60 days’ notice after their landlords agreed to sell.A recent report from the Mississippi Free Press includes a letter received by several households recently, reading in part:MZX denies all of the allegations against it. However, because MZX also requires property for its business purposes, MZX, through its real estate broker, is offering to purchase real estate in Southaven in exchange for, among other things, a release of all claims related to the lawsuit. If you decide to accept MZX’s offer, MZX will ask you to sign a real estate contract under which you will agree to execute a separate release agreement at the closing of the real estate transaction.Importantly, by executing the Release Agreement, you will be releasing possible claims you might have related to the Southaven Plant, including any claims you may have in connection with the Haley action. After executing the Release Agreement, you will be unable to recover any damages or other relief from the Haley lawsuit, and you will also be unable to bring claims on your own behalf. The Release Agreement provides further details on which claims would be released.As reported by The Guardian, xAI offered to purchase the homes if the owners don’t join a lawsuit filed by three residents, who accuse the company’s massive data center and gas-fired turbines of emitting “near-constant noise” and vibrations. xAI has ramped up its data center buildout over the past couple of years, constructing two sprawling “Colossus” facilities in Memphis, while bringing its “Macrohardrr” data center and an accompanying power plant to Southaven, which is located just over the Tennessee border.Growing opposition to AI data centers is putting pressure on politicians in the weeks leading up to the midterm elections. Last week, Memphis City Council voted down a one-year moratorium on AI data center development, and instead adopted an ordinance that would pause construction for 135 days. After Mississippi’s governor touted the company’s plan to invest more than $20 billion in the area earlier this year, SpaceXAI recently reported it’s facing up to $6.1 million in potential civil penalties for environmental law violations, along with more than $220 million in claims of unpaid bills for work performed at the Memphis and Southaven sites.In addition to a lawsuit filed by residents, xAI is also facing legal action from the National Association for the Advancement of Colored People (NAACP), which accuses the company of operating dozens of unpermitted methane gas turbines in Southaven. A federal judge blocked the Trump administration’s attempt to dismiss the lawsuit earlier this month.

items.titleZh: xAI正买断承诺不就数据中心噪音起诉的房主
items.descriptionZh:
据《卫报》报道，埃隆·马斯克旗下xAI的一家子公司正提出购买美国密西西比州Southaven社区的多套住宅，条件是房主不加入针对该公司附近数据中心和电厂的一场诉讼。报道称，一名房地产经纪人逐户通知居民，xAI计划购买418套住宅，并称已有18名房主计划出售。当地租户则表示，在房东同意出售后，他们已被要求60天内搬离。

《密西西比自由新闻》获得的信件显示，xAI子公司MZX在信中否认所有针对它的指控，但表示公司因业务需要房产，因此通过房地产经纪商提出购买Southaven的房地产，交换条件包括放弃与诉讼相关的全部索赔。若居民接受报价，需签署房地产合同，并在交易交割时另行签署释放协议。该协议将使其放弃与Southaven电厂相关的潜在索赔，包括与Haley诉讼有关的索赔；签署后，居民将无法从Haley诉讼中获得损害赔偿或其他救济，也不能自行提起诉讼。

《卫报》称，xAI提出购房的条件是业主不加入三名居民提起的诉讼。该诉讼指控xAI的大型数据中心和燃气轮机产生“近乎持续不断的噪音”和振动。过去几年，xAI加速数据中心建设，在孟菲斯建设了两座大型“Colossus”设施，并将“Macrohardrr”数据中心及配套电厂带到位于田纳西州边界另一侧的Southaven。从技术上看，这类AI数据中心通常由大规模GPU集群组成，用于训练和运行大模型，功耗和散热需求极高；xAI通过自建燃气轮机电厂进行现场供电，可缩短接入电网的时间、支撑快速扩张，但也带来排放、噪音、振动和许可合规等争议。其创新点更多体现在算力基础设施与能源供应的垂直整合和快速部署，而非单一芯片技术。

报道指出，针对AI数据中心的反对声正在中期选举前给政客带来压力。上周，孟菲斯市议会否决了为期一年的AI数据中心开发暂停令，转而通过一项暂停建设135天的条例。密西西比州州长今年早些时候曾宣传该公司计划在该地区投资超过200亿美元；但SpaceXAI最近报告称，公司面临最高610万美元的环境违法潜在民事罚款，以及孟菲斯和Southaven工地已完成工作超过2.2亿美元的未付账单索赔。

除居民诉讼外，xAI还面临美国全国有色人种协进会（NAACP）的法律行动。NAACP指控该公司在Southaven运营数十台未获许可的甲烷燃气轮机。本月早些时候，一名联邦法官阻止了特朗普政府试图驳回该诉讼的努力。整体来看，此案凸显AI数据中心快速扩张中的土地、能源、环境合规和社区关系风险：企业以购房换取撤诉的做法引发道德和法律争议，而地方政治、环境诉讼和财务索赔可能影响其超大规模算力基础设施的推进。

items.title: Standalone Nvidia Vera CPUs land in Oracle Cloud's multi-gigawatt deployment
items.description: Nvidia’s Vera CPU is now generally available on Oracle’s OCI Superclusters, a win for Nvidia as it moves past NVL72 to a standalone Vera deployment at a major hyperscaler.
items.content: Share Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Nvidia and Oracle have announced general availability of Nvidia’s Vera Rubin NVL72 rack and Vera CPUs on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Superclusters at Oracle AI World on Tuesday. The announcement comes hot on the heels of Google Cloud announcing general availability for Vera Rubin last week, putting two major hyperscaler feathers in Nvidia’s cap. However, Oracle’s announcement is interesting, specifically calling out standalone Vera instances on OCI Superclusters. We've included a few benchmarks we've performed on a Vera server for a forthcoming review to highlight some of the chip's performance characteristics, but do note that these tests were not conducted on OCI infrastructure.Neoclouds have been banging the drum of Vera for the past several weeks, with instances under way at Nscale, CoreWeave, and Nebius, among others, so it makes sense to see Vera in the GPU-dominant and AI-focused neoclouds. A standalone deployment at a hyperscaler like Oracle sends a different signal, however.Although hyperscalers maintain large fleets of hardware, sometimes even renting from the neoclouds, the CPU focus is primarily on x86, with OCI Superclusters otherwise offering the Ampere Altra for an Arm-based instance. It’s Nvidia’s first standalone CPU push into the hyperscale data center, placing Vera alongside the x86 competition regardless of the GPU compute.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Vera is not meant to upend the x86 guard, at least in isolation. Ian Buck, Nvidia’s mind behind CUDA and the face of Nvidia’s AI infrastructure buildout, said in March — when the chip was revealed — that the world couldn’t be served by a single, 88-core SKU. However, Vera is opening the door at hyperscalers like Oracle to expand in future CPU generations.AMD and Intel maintain the lead when it comes to single-socket density, which is only set to expand in the next generation, as AMD’s upcoming EPYC Venice CPUs can pack up to 512 threads in a single socket. However, Vera offers some distinct advantages due to its topology depending on the workload, many of which are becoming increasingly relevant in the agentic AI era. You may like Modal taps Nvidia Vera CPUs after firm's internal tests show 2x throughput over Intel and AMD chips Hot Chips 2026: Nvidia breaks down 88-core Vera CPU SpaceXAI will deploy standalone Nvidia Vera CPUs for Grok's agentic workloads Memory bandwidth, for instance, is one of Vera’s strong suits, and that’s not just a marketing claim. Nvidia has said the memory system is capable of 1.2 TB/s of bandwidth, but we can see Nvidia’s lead outside of theoretical numbers in our testing below. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)Take the industry-standard Stream benchmark as an example. Nvidia’s use of LPDDR5X-9600, along with a monolithic die and distributed mesh for caching, allows it to more than double the bandwidth available on a dual Intel Xeon 6980P system, even when it’s paired with MRDIMMs sporting speeds of 8,800 MT/s. We’re showing triad here, as it’s the most “demanding” of Stream’s operations, but the leads for Vera are similar across add, copy, and scale as well.This bandwidth is critical for some types of agentic loops, particularly those dealing with large database queries or extensive documentation. You can see the OpenMP “spread” policy offers a massive boost to Vera’s memory bandwidth, as well. Both AMD and Intel maintain centralized memory control and system-level cache, while Vera distributes it in a mesh across the die. The result, at least in OpenMP set properly, is much higher memory bandwidth by binding processes as far away from each other as possible.Another critical performance vector for agentic AI is Python. The agentic world is expanding, but much of the foundation of the AI software ecosystem is built on Python. Common agentic frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph are written in Python, and although we’re seeing more frameworks built in languages like Rust and TypeScript, Python performance is still critical to agentic loops. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)And, unsurprisingly, it’s an area where Vera is also strong, beating out CPUs that are much more powerful on paper. Popular agentic harnesses are built on Python, but so are many of the applications that also run on Python, including foundational AI libraries like PyTorch and TensorFlow. What to read next OpenAI’s Jalapeño ASICs are deployed alongside AMD EPYC ‘Turin’ CPUs as hosts, not Nvidia's Vera AMD targets Nvidia with first official benchmarks for EPYC 'Venice' CPUs Nvidia expects to sell $20 billion worth of Vera Rubin hardware this quarter Nvidia’s focus on agentic AI makes sense given the times we’re living in, but it can miss the forest for the trees. Oracle bringing Vera standalone instances online shifts the focus onto the broader implications of Vera’s entrance into the data center. There are some aspects of performance that characterize agentic AI workloads, but many agent workloads are regular data center workloads in the first place, just under high concurrency. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)For instance, SQLite performance is important for any server querying a large database, regardless of its written by logic, a person, or an AI agent. Nvidia’s second-gen Scalable Coherency Fabric (SCF), which we saw at play in Stream, shows up in a real workload here, with these database queries largely bound by data movement across the system.And that is what makes Vera so interesting in the context of Oracle’s announcement. It’s a CPU built for agentic AI, says Nvidia, but the crosstalk with general data center workloads is strong. It’s not just a CPU to use because you need access to Nvidia’s accelerators. Depending on the workload, it may even be a better choice than the x86 guard.Ultimately, we have to see how customers of these hyperscalers use (or don’t use) Vera in production. It’s demonstrated its usefulness in agentic AI loops, but it’s also showing early promise in certain general-purpose workloads. Oracle’s standalone deployment is a sign that there’s some demand for Vera that isn't exclusively tied at the hip of a Rubin GPU.Oracle is approaching cautiously, however, as any hyperscaler should be when bringing up a multi-gigawatt deployment. The company said it will also offer Nvidia’s HGX NVL8, bringing eight Rubin GPUs together in a cluster, connected to a dual, 64-core Intel Xeon 6 host with 4TB of DDR5 memory.Our testing of Vera shared in this article is part of a larger benchmarking session we had with the chip, and we'll share the technical details of the test setup in our forthcoming review. We’ll be publishing our full results shortly on Tom’s Hardware.

items.titleZh: 独立Nvidia Vera CPU落地甲骨文云多吉瓦级部署
items.descriptionZh:
Nvidia与Oracle在Oracle AI World上宣布，Nvidia的Vera Rubin NVL72机架和Vera CPU已在Oracle Cloud Infrastructure（OCI）Superclusters上正式可用。此前一周，Google Cloud刚宣布Vera Rubin正式可用，使Nvidia接连拿下两家主要超大规模云厂商。Oracle此次公告的特别之处在于，它明确提供独立的Vera实例，而不仅是与Rubin GPU捆绑的部署。这意味着Nvidia首次将独立CPU推向超大规模数据中心，使Vera在不依赖GPU计算的情况下直接与x86阵营竞争。不过，Nvidia并不认为Vera会单独颠覆x86的主导地位。CUDA负责人Ian Buck曾表示，世界不可能只靠一个88核SKU来服务；但Vera为Oracle等超大规模客户未来扩展CPU产品代际打开了大门。

从技术上看，Vera的关键优势之一是内存带宽和拓扑设计。Nvidia称其内存系统带宽可达1.2 TB/s。在行业标准Stream基准测试中，Vera采用LPDDR5X-9600、单片式die和分布式mesh缓存，其Triad测试带宽超过双路Intel Xeon 6980P系统两倍以上，即使后者搭配8,800 MT/s的MRDIMM。AMD和Intel采用集中式内存控制和系统级缓存，而Vera在die上以mesh方式分布内存与缓存；在正确设置OpenMP的“spread”策略、将进程尽量分散绑定后，Vera可获得显著更高的内存带宽。这一特性对处理大型数据库查询或大量文档的agentic循环尤其重要。另一个关键性能维度是Python。CrewAI、LangGraph等主流agent框架以及PyTorch、TensorFlow等AI基础库都大量依赖Python，Vera在这一领域也表现强劲，甚至能击败纸面规格更强的CPU。作者同时强调，文中展示的Vera服务器基准测试并非在OCI基础设施上运行，而是其后续完整评测的一部分。

新闻进一步指出，Nvidia强调Vera面向agentic AI，但许多agent工作负载本质上仍是高并发的常规数据中心工作负载。例如SQLite数据库查询性能对所有查询大型数据库的服务器都很重要，无论查询逻辑由人还是AI agent编写。Vera的第二代Scalable Coherency Fabric（SCF）在Stream测试中已有体现，在真实数据库查询中也发挥作用，因为这类查询很大程度上受系统内数据移动限制。因此，Vera不仅是“需要访问Nvidia加速器时才用的CPU”，在部分通用负载中甚至可能比x86方案更合适。Oracle的独立部署表明，市场对Vera存在不完全依附于Rubin GPU的需求。但Oracle也保持谨慎：它还将提供Nvidia HGX NVL8，将八颗Rubin GPU组成集群，并连接双路64核Intel Xeon 6主机和4TB DDR5内存。最终，Vera在超大规模生产环境中的实际采用情况仍有待观察；它已在agentic AI循环中展示价值，并在某些通用工作负载上显露早期潜力。

items.title: IT vendor lists massive $60 million AI supercomputer on eBay with 300 racks of decommissioned GPUs
items.description: Someone listed a massive 300-rack AI supercomputer on eBay for $59.7M. Packed with 9,600 A100 GPUs and 4,200 EPYC CPUs, it even ships for free.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 8 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter If you ever wanted to own your own supercomputer or data center while earning eBay cashback, Core 4 Solutions has the perfect opportunity. The company is selling a 300-rack AI supercomputer on eBay for $59.7 million, complete with $50 overnight shipping, or free shipping if you're willing to go with FedEx Ground. The cluster packs 9,600 Nvidia A100 accelerators and 4,200 AMD EPYC Rome 64-core processors, enough to jump-start your own sovereign AI nation.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)The data center cooling state of playThe custom AI ASIC state of play America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the priceGTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this yearDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsibleNvidia and AMD have moved to newer architectures like Blackwell, Vera Rubin, and EPYC Turin. Nonetheless, A100 (codenamed Ampere) accelerators and EPYC Rome processors remain highly relevant for many computing tasks, including AI, machine learning, and scientific research. With the modern Blackwell and Vera Rubin racks from Nvidia, like the GB300 NVL72 and VR200 NVL72, costing up to $6.5 million and $7.8 million per unit, respectively, the A100 has turned into a legitimate budget alternative that can also circumvent the long waitlists and supply chain delays on Nvidia's newer AI hardware.The cluster's sheer specifications are truly jaw-dropping. Each rack has four compute nodes and three management nodes. Each compute node has two AMD EPYC Rome 64-core processors, eight Nvidia A100 40GB SXM4 accelerators, and 1TB of DDR4-2933 memory. The management nodes are no less impressive. Each features two EPYC 64-core chips and 192GB of DDR4 memory.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: When you sum it all up, the cluster comprises up to 9,600 A100 accelerators and 4,200 AMD EPYC Rome processors. With 64 Zen 2 execution cores per chip, the entire cluster boasts 268,800 cores. Memory capacity is equally impressive, with up to 1,401.6 TB or 1.4 petabytes for the entire cluster.300x ... 32x A100 Racks for sale for a cool 59.7 million USD.. https://t.co/DRDXfZlj9e I love that someone has this in their cart... https://t.co/Rw8MIV11qCOctober 27, 2026At first glance, $59.7 million sounds like a fortune, and it certainly is, but it seems like a reasonable valuation for the cluster. A rough estimate would be about $24 million for the A100S, $3 million for the EPYC Rome chips, and about $1.1 million for the DDR4 memory. That is about $28.1 million in crucial components, before factoring in other hardware like racks, cooling, power supplies, Nvidia Mellanox ConnectX-6 SmartNICs, etc. You may like Nvidia’s GB300-powered DGX Station desktop tower listed for nearly $100,000 online Reddit user pays $35 for a crypto mining rig left in a garage and gets 54GB of VRAM at 65 cents per GB CoreWeave proves Nvidia's aging AI GPUs from 2020 can generate profit nine years after deployment, signs A100 contracts into 2029 Listing a 300-rack supercomputing cluster on eBay sounds absurd, but given today's AI-driven world, it is not as surprising as it may seem. After all, a broker once sold a 405-foot luxury Gigayacht for $168 million on eBay, so there is no reason why Core 4 Solutions cannot move a $59.7 million cluster. As AI farms and data centers expand, some enterprise clients out there will recognize the value and opportunity in the listing.Shipping that many racks will be a logistics nightmare, and as funny as it sounds, Core 4 Solutions offers free local pickup or FedEx Ground delivery directly to your home. There is even an option to pay for a $25 two-day or $50 overnight delivery. Imagine FedEx casually dropping off 300 server racks at your front porch.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsThe cluster seems to have already drawn attention, with 11 people reportedly watching the eBay listing and one prospective buyer already letting it sit in their cart. I guess the real question is not whether it will sell, but whether the buyer will choose $50 overnight shipping. items.titleZh: IT供应商在eBay挂牌出售价值6000万美元的大型AI超级计算机，包含300机架退役GPU
items.descriptionZh:
Core 4 Solutions 正在 eBay 上以 5970 万美元挂牌出售一套 300 机柜的 AI 超级计算机集群，并开出 50 美元隔夜达、25 美元两日达、FedEx Ground 免费配送以及本地自提等物流选项。文章戏称，这套系统足以“启动一个主权 AI 国家”，也反映出高端 AI 算力正在成为一种可在公开平台上交易的特殊资产。

这套集群的核心配置包括 9600 块 Nvidia A100 40GB SXM4 加速器和 4200 颗 AMD EPYC Rome 64 核处理器，总计 268,800 个 CPU 核心，内存容量最高约 1,401.6TB，也就是约 1.4PB DDR4。每个机柜包含 4 个计算节点和 3 个管理节点；每个计算节点配备 2 颗 EPYC Rome 64 核处理器、8 块 A100 40GB SXM4 和 1TB DDR4-2933 内存；每个管理节点则配备 2 颗 EPYC 64 核处理器和 192GB DDR4 内存。文章按关键部件粗略估算，A100 约值 2400 万美元，EPYC Rome 处理器约 300 万美元，DDR4 内存约 110 万美元，合计约 2810 万美元，尚未计入机柜、冷却、电源以及 Nvidia Mellanox ConnectX-6 SmartNIC 等系统级硬件成本。

从技术代际看，A100 属于 Nvidia Ampere 架构，EPYC Rome 属于 AMD Zen 2 架构，均已不是最新产品；但它们在 AI、机器学习和科学研究等任务中仍具实用性。文章对比称，Nvidia 新一代 Blackwell 和 Vera Rubin 机柜系统，如 GB300 NVL72 和 VR200 NVL72，单套价格可高达 650 万美元和 780 万美元，且面临较长等待名单和供应链延迟。因此，A100 集群被视为一种“预算型替代方案”，可帮助需要成熟算力的客户绕开新品交付瓶颈。不过，新旧平台在单卡性能、能效和架构上差异明显，不能简单按机柜单价线性比较。

这笔交易的技术看点不在于新架构突破，而在于将大规模存量高端 AI 算力整体打包流通。此类集群适合 AI 训练与推理、机器学习、科学计算、HPC 以及主权 AI、云服务商和研究机构等场景，但 300 个机柜的部署需要大型机房、电力、冷却和高速网络支撑，并非普通用户可在家中运行。文章提到，该 eBay 列表已有 11 人关注、1 人将其加入购物车；无论最终是否成交，它都凸显了 AI 基础设施需求旺盛、A100 等旧代高端 GPU 仍具经济价值，以及二手/存量算力市场正在升温的趋势。

history.content: Google has released its latest frontier model, Gemini 4 Carbon, offering “significant gains” in coding, agentic tasks, and cybersecurity. In an announcement on Wednesday, Google highlights Carbon’s top spot on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (v5.0) benchmark, with Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra trailing behind.The new Gemini 4 Carbon model offers improvements over Argon, which Google released earlier this month. It’s currently only available to a select group of cybersecurity defense companies, but it will eventually expand to other partners in its Fairwind Program.Carbon sits ahead of Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra. Image: Artificial Analysis Intelligence IndexThe company says Carbon reflects the “pace at which we’re pushing the frontier forward,” coming with a “significant leap” in cyberdefense that makes it better at finding vulnerabilities and generating secure code. Carbon currently holds the number one spot on SEC-bench Pro, a benchmark that measures an AI model’s ability to discover real-world bugs, and ExploitGym, which measures how a model can turn a vulnerability into exploits.Gemini 4 Carbon also beat GPT-6 Astra on the SEC-bench Pro cybersecurity benchmark. Image: GoogleGoogle says Gemini 4 Carbon is built for completing longer tasks, adding that its internal teams have seen it “run for days to persist through dead ends to tackle complex, multi-step engineering tasks.” It’s also better at avoiding shortcuts, resisting prompt injection attacks, and collaborating with users, according to Google. Carbon is supposed to offer more “transparency and honesty” as well, by cutting “unsupported claims” by two times when compared to Argon.It will launch at the same competitive introductory price as Argon, at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens.

Google 发布了最新前沿模型 Gemini 4 Carbon，称其在编程、代理型任务和网络安全方面取得“显著提升”。谷歌在周三的公告中强调，Gemini 4 Carbon 在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index（v5.0）基准上排名第一，Claude Opus 5.5 和 GPT-6 Astra 位列其后。该模型相较谷歌本月初发布的 Argon 有所改进。目前 Gemini 4 Carbon 仅向部分网络安全防御公司开放，未来将逐步扩展至 Fairwind Program 中的其他合作伙伴。

谷歌表示，Carbon 体现了公司“推进前沿的速度”，并在网络防御能力上实现“显著跃升”，使其更擅长发现漏洞和生成安全代码。Carbon 目前在 SEC-bench Pro 和 ExploitGym 两项基准上均排名第一：前者衡量 AI 模型发现真实世界漏洞的能力，后者衡量模型将漏洞转化为利用方式的能力。谷歌还称，Gemini 4 Carbon 在 SEC-bench Pro 网络安全基准上击败了 GPT-6 Astra。

在技术能力上，谷歌称 Carbon 专为完成更长任务而构建，内部团队已看到它“连续运行数天，在遇到死胡同后仍能坚持推进，以处理复杂、多步骤的工程任务”。它还被描述为更擅长避免走捷径、抵御提示注入攻击以及与用户协作。谷歌表示，Carbon 还旨在提供更高的“透明度和诚实度”，与 Argon 相比将“无依据声明”减少两倍。

定价方面，Gemini 4 Carbon 将采用与 Argon 相同的竞争性 introductory price：每百万输入 token 2 美元，每百万输出 token 10 美元。整体来看，Carbon 的发布显示出前沿模型竞争正从通用能力进一步延伸到长时程代理任务、安全代码生成和网络安全攻防基准；其当前受限开放策略也表明，谷歌希望先在网络安全防御场景中验证高风险能力，再扩大合作伙伴范围。原文未披露具体模型架构，因此其创新主要体现在长任务持久性、抗提示注入、减少无依据输出以及网络安全基准表现上。

history.title: Malaysia seizes $12 million worth of advanced AI chips hidden inside 30 servers
history.description: Malaysian customs seized 30 servers containing more than $12 million worth of advanced AI chips at Kuala Lumpur International Airport, as authorities investigate a suspected smuggling network linked to multiple previous seizures.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Malaysian customs have seized over $12 million (49.5 million Malaysian ringgit) worth of advanced AI chips in a single bust, as the country clamps down on a suspected semiconductor smuggling syndicate. According to a Reuters report on October 28, officials found 30 servers containing the chips at Kuala Lumpur International Airport’s free trade zone on October 15th. Initial investigations revealed that the shipment originated in an Asian country and was bound for another undisclosed Asian country.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)The data center cooling state of playThe custom AI ASIC state of play America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the priceGTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this yearDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsibleThe airport’s customs director, Aspalila Ag Tuah, confirmed that the servers were falsely declared as ordinary electronic goods, saying the suspected scheme used Malaysia as a transit point to avoid restrictions on the goods’ onward movement. The Malaysian company involved in the shipment has been summoned to assist in the investigation.Authorities suspect that the foiled smuggling attempt was carried out by the same group responsible for a similar attempt last June. On June 5, customs officers discovered 72 server units containing advanced AI chips at the Kuala Lumpur International Airport, valued at approximately $13 million. This shipment had also been falsely declared as computer components and was meant to be reshipped without the required permit. Aspalila said the network has been linked to seizures worth over $25 million so far across at least five cases. She declined to provide further information on the network or the current case, citing ongoing investigations.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Several key facts remain unknown, including the chip type, country of manufacture, final destination, and intended recipient — whether a company or a military organization. The U.S. had placed export controls on the movement of advanced Nvidia and other U.S.-origin AI chips to China, the most likely destination for the seized chips. Smuggling networks began using Malaysia, a U.S. ally not affected by the controls, as a hub, exporting the banned chips to the country before re-exporting them to China.While the country’s geographic location and mature logistics infrastructure make it important for legitimate international trade, these characteristics also make it ideal for smuggling sensitive technology. To restrict this avenue, Malaysia subsequently imposed export controls on the ​movement of advanced AI chips of U.S. origin, at Washington’s request. Other Asian U.S. allies, such as Singapore and Taiwan, have implemented similar controls. Demand for powerful Nvidia GPUs remains high in China, fueling a booming market for smuggled hardware. history.titleZh: 马来西亚查获藏在30台服务器内的价值1200万美元先进AI芯片
history.descriptionZh:
马来西亚海关近日在吉隆坡国际机场自由贸易区查获一批价值超过1200万美元（4950万马来西亚林吉特）的先进AI芯片，这是该国打击疑似半导体走私网络的一次重大行动。据路透社10月28日报道，海关官员于10月15日发现30台装有先进AI芯片的服务器。初步调查显示，这批货物源自某个亚洲国家，目的地是另一个未披露的亚洲国家。吉隆坡国际机场海关关长阿斯帕利拉·阿格·图阿证实，涉事服务器被虚假申报为普通电子产品，疑似走私方案利用马来西亚作为中转站，以规避相关货物继续转运所受的限制。涉案马来西亚公司已被传唤协助调查。

当局怀疑，此次被挫败的走私企图与今年6月一起类似案件由同一团伙实施。6月5日，海关官员曾在吉隆坡国际机场发现72台装有先进AI芯片的服务器，价值约1300万美元。该批货物同样被虚假申报为计算机组件，并计划在未取得所需许可的情况下再出口。阿斯帕利拉表示，该网络目前至少与5起案件相关，涉案查获总值已超过2500万美元。由于调查仍在进行，她拒绝透露该网络或当前案件的更多信息。

目前仍有若干关键事实不明，包括芯片类型、制造国、最终目的地以及预期收货方——无论是企业还是军事组织。美国已对先进英伟达及其他美国原产AI芯片的对华流动实施出口管制，而中国被认为是这些被查获芯片最可能的目的地。走私网络开始利用马来西亚作为枢纽：马来西亚是美国盟友，不受上述管制影响，走私者先将受禁芯片出口至马来西亚，再转运至中国。马来西亚的地理位置和成熟物流基础设施使其对合法国际贸易十分重要，但同样使其成为走私敏感技术的理想中转地。为限制这一渠道，马来西亚随后应华盛顿要求，对美国原产先进AI芯片的流动实施出口管制。新加坡和台湾等其他亚洲美国盟友也实施了类似管制。中国对强大英伟达GPU的需求仍然旺盛，推动了走私硬件的繁荣市场。

从技术层面看，原文所称“先进AI芯片”通常指用于数据中心AI训练和推理的GPU或AI加速器，其核心能力在于并行计算，可加速矩阵运算等深度学习工作负载，因而成为大模型训练、推理、高性能计算和云数据中心的关键硬件。此类芯片受出口管制，主要因其高算力可用于人工智能、超级计算及潜在军事用途。不过，原文并未披露被查获芯片的具体型号、算力、显存带宽、互连能力或能效等性能参数，也未提供不同芯片之间的对比数据，因此无法就此次查获硬件的具体性能作出量化分析。案件目前更多体现出口管制执行、转口贸易合规和跨国走私网络问题，而非某一新款芯片的技术创新。

该事件的影响主要体现在三方面：一是显示美国对华AI芯片出口管制正推动走私网络利用第三国中转，促使马来西亚、新加坡和台湾等美国盟友加强协同管制；二是对马来西亚的转口贸易、自由贸易区监管和企业合规提出更高要求，涉事公司可能面临调查和法律责任；三是凸显中国市场对高端英伟达GPU的强劲需求，以及算力获取受限背景下地下硬件市场的持续活跃。应用场景方面，此类芯片主要面向AI模型训练与推理、数据中心加速、科学计算等；一旦非法流转，可能影响受控技术的最终用途和供应链安全。总体而言，此案是AI芯片出口管制收紧后，围绕第三国转运、虚假申报和走私网络展开的最新执法案例，但被查获芯片的具体技术规格和最终流向仍有待调查披露。

history.content: Following improvements made to Chrome’s enhanced autofill last year that included your name, passport number, email address, and physical addresses sourced from your Google Accounts and services like Google Wallet, the feature is now expanding. Starting today, Chrome’s enhanced autofill will use Gemini with Personal Intelligence to suggest information sourced from your Gmail, potentially saving you from having to search for confirmation emails, receipts, or shipping updates yourself.The expanded autofill capabilities can retrieve details such as a shipment’s tracking number, travel details like a flight booking number or hotel reservation, or the order number of a recent purchase. Sensitive data presented as a suggestion while completing a form remains encrypted, and users can manage what enhanced autofill has access to in Chrome’s settings, or turn it off completely.Chrome can suggest details automatically pulled from your Gmail account so you can complete forms without constantly hopping between browser tabs. Image: GoogleGoogle is starting to roll out the enhanced autofill improvements today in the US. They’ll be available through Gemini in Chrome for users with Personal Intelligence turned on in the desktop, Android, and iOS versions of the browser.

history.titleZh: Chrome增强版自动填充现可从Gmail获取信息，助你填写表单
history.descriptionZh:
Chrome的增强自动填充功能再次扩展。此前，该功能已能基于Google账户以及Google Wallet等服务，自动填充姓名、护照号码、电子邮件地址和物理地址等信息；现在，Chrome将引入Gemini的Personal Intelligence能力，从用户的Gmail中提取信息并生成填充建议，帮助用户免去手动搜索确认邮件、收据或物流更新邮件的麻烦。可检索的信息包括物流跟踪号、航班预订号、酒店预订信息以及近期购买的订单号等。用户在填写表单时看到的敏感数据建议仍保持加密；用户可在Chrome设置中管理增强自动填充的访问范围，或完全关闭该功能。

从技术原理看，这一功能将Gemini的个人智能能力与浏览器表单填写场景结合：系统在获得用户授权后，从Gmail邮件中识别并提取结构化字段，再结合当前网页表单的输入需求生成自动填充建议。其创新点在于，自动填充的数据来源从相对静态的个人资料和账户信息，扩展到Gmail中的动态业务信息，使浏览器能在不频繁切换标签页、不手动查找邮件的情况下完成表单填写。安全与权限控制方面，敏感建议数据保持加密，并提供设置项供用户管理或关闭功能。

原文未披露准确率、响应延迟、支持表单类型数量等量化性能指标，因此暂无具体性能参数可比。与上一代增强自动填充相比，主要变化是新增Gmail作为建议来源，并将可填充内容从身份和地址信息扩展到物流、旅行和订单等邮件上下文信息。该功能将率先在美国逐步推出，面向在桌面端、Android和iOS版Chrome中开启Personal Intelligence的用户，通过Chrome中的Gemini提供。其应用场景主要包括电商物流查询、订单号填写、航班和酒店预订信息录入等。该扩展有望减少用户在邮件与网页表单之间复制粘贴和切换标签页的操作，提高表单填写效率；但同时，由于涉及Gmail个人数据，隐私授权、数据加密和用户可控性将成为该功能落地的重要前提。

history.title: Amazon tells engineers to stop ‘tokenmaxxing’ to look productive
history.description: Amazon has published new engineering guidelines warning developers and managers against ‘tokenmaxxing,’ arguing that AI usage metrics are ‘deeply flawed’ unless tied to long-term outcomes. The move follows similar spending concerns at Uber and Accenture.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 5 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Amazon wants its engineers to quit chasing token counts, warning that heavy AI usage does not automatically mean better work. In updated engineering guidelines published on October 27, the company laid out how developers and managers should gauge AI’s real impact — and the takeaway is blunt: consuming more tokens is not the same as delivering more value. Amazon is not backing away from the technology, though. “We are certain that whatever future best practices are, AI will be at the center of software engineering practice,” the company wrote.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)The data center cooling state of playThe custom AI ASIC state of play America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the priceGTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this yearDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsibleThe guidance targets ‘tokenmaxxing,’ a practice where employees deliberately inflate their AI usage to look productive on internal dashboards. According to the memo, metrics such as AI adoption rates, token consumption, code changes, and code reviews become ‘deeply flawed’ when they are disconnected from actual results. Turning them into targets, Amazon says, encourages wasteful behavior that clashes with its emphasis on ‘frugality and simplicity’ and can raise both compute bills and software complexity.The company’s preferred yardstick is long-term results. “We believe that it is best to measure, and be measured by, long-term outcomes,” Amazon wrote. That does not mean managers should ignore usage data altogether, as input metrics remain useful when examined ‘with care and judgment’ alongside other indicators. Amazon suggests looking at both the teams using AI the least and those using it the most to determine whether adoption is translating into better delivery.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The push comes as Amazon, under CEO Andy Jassy, has been weaving AI deeply into its sprawling operations. Jassy said earlier this year that the technology will ‘change the scope and speed’ of everyday work, and he has suggested that automation could shrink the company’s corporate workforce over the next few years — though he also expects it to create ‘other jobs.’The memo also pushes back on the idea that every task needs an AI tool. If current tooling does not benefit someone’s work, Amazon says, that is ‘a finding, not a failing.’ Engineers who can explain where today’s tools fall short are demonstrating judgment rather than reluctance to adopt AI. Workers reportedly used MeshClaw, an internal AI agent capable of handling tasks such as deploying code and interacting with Slack, to inflate their token counts.Notably, Amazon is not the only company rethinking how it spends on AI. Uber president and COO Andrew Macdonald said in May that higher token usage has yet to translate into useful consumer features. “That link is not there yet,” he said. The remark stands out because Uber’s CTO previously revealed that the company had burned through its entire 2026 Claude Code budget by April.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsAccenture appears to also be wrestling with the same problem on behalf of its clients. Leaked audio obtained by 404 Media in June captures executives acknowledging that token spending is climbing fast as companies move from simple chatbots to agentic workflows, and that nobody can reliably predict what a given task will cost or whether it was worth the money. Accenture’s agentic AI strategy lead described it as ‘not a niche problem,’ and the firm is reportedly building an advisory tool called ‘Token IQ’ to help customers manage the bill. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has previously acknowledged that AI token costs had become 'a huge issue', as companies faced mounting bills from heavy AI use.Amazon, however, says it has not imposed token caps on its employees. According to CNBC, however, it shut down an internal leaderboard in May after workers were found gaming it to climb the rankings — an early example of the behavior the new guidelines are meant to discourage. history.titleZh: 亚马逊要求工程师停止“刷Token”以显得高效
history.descriptionZh:
亚马逊在10月27日更新的工程指南中明确警告员工：不要一味追求AI token使用量，消耗更多token并不等于创造更多价值。公司同时强调，这并不意味着亚马逊要远离AI；相反，亚马逊认为无论未来最佳实践如何演变，AI都将处于软件工程实践的中心。

这份指南主要针对“tokenmaxxing”现象，即员工为了在内部看板上显得更高效，刻意抬高自己的AI使用量。亚马逊指出，AI采用率、token消耗量、代码变更和代码审查等指标，一旦与实际结果脱节，就会变成“严重有缺陷”的指标；把这些指标当成目标，会鼓励浪费行为，与公司强调的“节俭和简洁”相冲突，还可能推高计算账单、增加软件复杂度。亚马逊更倾向以长期结果作为衡量标准，但也不主张完全忽视使用数据：输入指标在“谨慎判断”并与其他指标结合时仍有价值。公司建议同时观察AI使用最少和使用最多的团队，判断采用AI是否真正转化为更好的交付。

指南还反驳了“每项任务都需要AI工具”的想法。亚马逊表示，如果现有工具不能改善某人的工作，这是“一个发现，而不是失败”；工程师能够解释当前工具的不足，体现的是判断力，而不是不愿采用AI。背景是，亚马逊在CEO Andy Jassy带领下正把AI深度嵌入各项业务。Jassy今年早些时候称，这项技术将“改变日常工作的范围和速度”，并暗示未来几年自动化可能缩小公司企业员工规模，但也会创造“其他工作”。

今年5月有报道称，在要求使用公司工具的压力下，亚马逊员工曾不必要地使用AI来提高内部使用分数。员工据称使用内部AI智能体MeshClaw来抬高token计数，该工具可执行部署代码、与Slack交互等任务。值得注意的是，亚马逊并非唯一重新思考AI支出的公司。Uber总裁兼COO Andrew Macdonald今年5月表示，更高的token使用量尚未转化为有用的消费者功能，“这种联系还不存在”。Uber CTO此前还透露，公司在4月就用完了2026年全年的Claude Code预算。咨询公司埃森哲也面临类似问题。404 Media 6月获得的泄露音频显示，高管承认随着企业从简单聊天机器人转向智能体工作流，token支出快速上升，且没人能可靠预测某项任务的花费或是否值得。埃森哲的智能体AI战略负责人称这“不是一个小众问题”，公司据称正在构建名为“Token IQ”的咨询工具，帮助客户管理账单。OpenAI CEO Sam Altman此前也承认，AI token成本已成为“一个巨大问题”。

不过，亚马逊表示并未对员工设置token上限。据CNBC报道，亚马逊曾在5月关闭一个内部排行榜，因为发现员工通过刷量来提升排名——这正是新指南希望抑制的行为的一个早期案例。整体来看，亚马逊的新规反映出企业AI管理正从“采用率竞赛”转向“结果导向”，要求管理者在使用数据与长期产出之间做出更审慎的权衡。

history.content: NVIDIA RTX Spark powers thin and light laptops built for everything that developers, creators and gamers do. These powerful systems combine an NVIDIA Blackwell RTX GPU and an NVIDIA Grace CPU in a single superchip with up to 128GB of unified memory and up to 1 petaflop of FP4 AI performance. That puts the NVIDIA CUDA platform, RTX graphics and the capabilities of a personal AI supercomputer inside premium Windows laptops built to go anywhere. New and expected RTX Spark updates, coming soon, include: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an open weight speech model for transcription, speaker attribution and translation is available on RTX Spark. The LFM3 family of open models with day-zero support. Resource management controls in NVIDIA App to allocate GPU resources between foreground apps and background agents. Phantom Blade Zero, S-GAME’s highly-anticipated action role-playing game, launches with ray tracing and NVIDIA DLSS 4.5. Experience Minecraft with path tracing and DLSS with RTX Remix1.6, available now for RTX Spark. Turn Recorded Audio Into Useful Information With NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe Introduced today, NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe is a new, open weight speech model that turns recorded conversations into useful information. Instead of needing multiple models for transcription, speaker labels and translation, developers can use one promptable model that handles all three, plus questions about the audio. It transcribes 40 languages, including seven Indic languages. Developers guide the model with plain-language prompts. For example, for a single recorded meeting, users can ask it to: “Transcribe this recording and label each speaker.” “Translate this audio into English.” “List what decisions were made in this meeting.” Prompts can also include product terms and formatting conventions, which helps the model handle specialized vocabulary in fields like healthcare, financial services and customer service. Because the weights are open, developers can choose where audio is processed, from a desktop to the cloud. Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe ranks No. 1 on the Hugging Face Open ASR and No. 2 among open weight models on Artificial Analysis — delivering leading accuracy with approximately 4.3 billion active parameters, 80% fewer than the No. 1 open weight model, making high-quality, intelligent transcription more practical on local hardware. It’s available today on Hugging Face. Quantized versions are coming soon, so developers can run Transcribe locally onNVIDIA RTX Spark and DGX Spark systems, Jetson AGX Thor devices or scale up on NVIDIA Blackwell data center GPUs. NVFP4 versions will be deployable through NeMo-Speech.cpp or vLLM. Learn more in the NVIDIA technical blog. Control How Agents and PC Apps Share GPU Resources On RTX Spark, users can have long-running agents working alongside their favorite applications. Both share the system’s GPU compute, and the right balance of resources depends on what matters to users at that moment. With the new resource management feature in NVIDIA App, users can now choose how GPU resources are shared. They can prioritize their foreground app for the best performance, or give their background-running agent more resources to get work done faster. Access control resource sharing from System > Advanced in the NVIDIA App. This feature requires hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling to be enabled in Windows Settings. Liquid AI: One Model Family, Many Ways to Work Liquid AI’s LFM3 provides a new generation of Liquid Foundation Models designed for specialized tasks. The family spans text, vision, audio, omni and decision models built on one shared backbone, with base and post-trained models available as open weights. The models are compact and fast: Liquid AI’s new 1.7-billion-parameter base model outperforms its previous 2.6-billion-parameter base model. These models support local workflows such as agents running in Hermes Agent, Pi and OpenClaw to triage inboxes and manage calendars, read documents and app screens, transcribe and translate speech, answer spoken questions about handwritten math, and route support tickets or voice requests. Developers can run LFM3 models on RTX Spark with native support through llama.cpp and vLLM, and fine-tune the models locally. ‘Phantom Blade Zero’ Launches With DLSS 4.5 S-GAME’s Phantom Blade Zero launches tonight, Oct. 28, at 7 p.m. PT on Steam and the Epic Games Store. Players can take on the role of Soul, a swordsman framed for his master’s murder, as he travels the martial world to uncover a conspiracy. NVIDIA worked with S-GAME Studio and S-GAME Publishing to add ray-traced effects to the title. On RTX Spark laptops and GeForce RTX GPU-powered PCs, ray tracing adds more accurate bounced lighting, detailed reflections and realistic shadows on foliage and terrain. The NVIDIA DLSS Dynamic Multi Frame Generation feature boosts frame rates with up to 6x frame generation, or adjusts the multiplier on the fly to hit a player’s target frame rate. Read more on GeForce.com. RTX Remix Breathes New Life Into Classics NVIDIA RTX Remix, the modding platform for remastering classic games with path tracing and DLSS, released version 1.6 last week. This update brought RTX Remix to the world’s largest gaming community: Minecraft. Both creators and players can render Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.1 through RTX Remix with DLSS-accelerated path tracing and take full advantage of realistic lighting and materials in their future creations. The update also adds DLSS 5 with 3D-Guided Neural Rendering, up to 6x Multi Frame Generation, native RTX Spark support and agent-assisted workflows. Starting today, those upgrades come to Portal with RTX and the Half-Life 2 RTX demo. Both now support RTX Spark, with DLSS 3D-Guided Neural Rendering for more lifelike lighting and materials, a new Performance Mode for DLSS Frame Generation and new options that speed up path tracing. RTX Remix 1.6 also makes AI-powered modding simpler. A redesigned ComfyUI workflow lets modders generate physically based materials directly inside RTX Remix, with no application programming interface setup, batch processing for full projects and presets for less technical creators. Plus, with NVIDIA agent skills, compatible AI agents can work directly with RTX Remix to help speed up remastering projects. Learn more in the RTX Remix blog. RTX Spark Laptops: Beautifully Designed, Built for Everything RTX Spark laptops come in a range of designs, so users can choose one that fits how they work and play. Options include different screen sizes, colors, touchscreens, pen support and two-in-one convertibles. RTX Spark laptops are as thin as 14mm and as light as three pounds, with all-day battery life. Such slim designs are possible because RTX Spark places the GPU, CPU and up to 128GB of unified memory on one power-efficient superchip. Creative projects and AI models draw from the same memory pool, so a laptop can take on work that used to call for a desktop workstation, even when unplugged. Here’s what this means for: AI developers: Run models and agents locally on NVIDIA CUDA — the same platform that powers AI in the cloud — with a path to deploy across more than 150 million NVIDIA RTX AI PCs and NVIDIA GPUs in the cloud. Creators: RTX Spark can edit camera native 4:2:2 video and render 3D scenes of up to 90GB. Adobe Photoshop and Premiere offer native RTX Spark support through beta releases. Gamers: Hundreds of games run on RTX Spark, with NVIDIA DLSS, ray tracing, Reflex and G-SYNC delivering sharper visuals and smoother, more responsive gameplay. RTX Spark laptops are available now from ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI, starting at $2,599, with 128GB configurations on shelves. Find a laptop on the RTX Spark product page. #ICYMI: More Updates From NVIDIA Local AI 🦆Microducks learn to walk with help from RTX Spark: During the GTC Berlin keynote, NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang showed how AI agents running on RTX Spark can help train Hugging Face’s Microduck robot. A new NVIDIA technical blog walks through the workflow: Hermes Agent and Nemotron 3.5 Bolt plan an obstacle course on RTX Spark, Astra builds the 3D assets, NVIDIA Isaac Lab trains the navigation policy and RTX Spark validates it in NVIDIA Isaac Sim. Watch the demo and try the playbook. ⚡NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB is now available, enabling natural conversations and multistep agent tasks with as little as 4GB of memory. The model powers local voice assistants, game characters and embedded interfaces on RTX Spark, DGX Spark, GeForce RTX GPUs and NVIDIA Jetson devices. It supports llama.cpp, vLLM, Ollama, Unsloth and LM Studio, and works with Hermes and OpenClaw. For more demanding agent workloads, Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB is designed to run local agents on RTX Spark. 🖼️Black Forest Labs’ FLUX 3 Image Klein is a 5.6-billion-parameter open weights model that lets users generate and edit images locally. NVIDIA-optimized versions run on RTX GPUs with as little as 8GB of VRAM. Developers can also fine-tune the model on RTX Spark using an NVIDIA NeMo AutoModel recipe to customize it for specific creative workflows. 🖥️NVIDIA DGX Spark 64GB is now available to purchase from manufacturer partners, giving developers and researchers another way to build and run AI locally. Powered by the GB10 Grace Blackwell Superchip, it combines 64GB of unified memory with DGX OS and the NVIDIA AI software stack for agent development, inference and fine-tuning. Learn more and explore purchase options. Follow NVIDIA RTX Spark on X, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook — and stay informed by subscribing to the NVIDIA Local AI newsletter. history.titleZh: 轻薄全能：NVIDIA RTX Spark Windows笔记本电脑新增多款机型、智能体工具及游戏
history.descriptionZh:
英伟达宣布，RTX Spark 笔记本电脑已由华硕、戴尔、惠普、联想、微软和微星推出。该产品面向开发者、创作者和游戏玩家，定位为轻薄高性能 Windows 笔记本，核心是将 Blackwell 架构 RTX GPU 与 Grace CPU 集成在单一超级芯片中，最高配备 128GB 统一内存和最高 1 PFLOPS FP4 AI 性能，从而把 CUDA 平台、RTX 图形能力和“个人 AI 超级计算机”能力装进便携设备。RTX Spark 笔记本起售价 2599 美元，128GB 配置已上架。

**产品形态与技术架构**

RTX Spark 的关键创新在于“超级芯片 + 统一内存”架构。GPU、CPU 和最高 128GB 内存共享同一内存池，减少传统 PC 中 CPU 内存与 GPU 显存之间的数据搬运和容量分割。这意味着笔记本可以本地运行更大 AI 模型、渲染最高 90GB 的 3D 场景，并编辑相机原生 4:2:2 视频。高能效单芯片设计使产品最薄约 14mm、最轻约 3 磅（约 1.36kg），具备全天电池续航，并提供不同屏幕尺寸、颜色、触控、手写笔和二合一形态。

对开发者而言，RTX Spark 运行 NVIDIA CUDA 平台，与云端 AI 平台同源，可把本地开发成果扩展到超过 1.5 亿台 RTX AI PC 和云端 NVIDIA GPU。对创作者而言，Adobe Photoshop 和 Premiere 已通过 beta 版本提供原生 RTX Spark 支持。对游戏玩家而言，数百款游戏可在 RTX Spark 上运行，并支持 DLSS、光线追踪、Reflex 和 G-SYNC。

**AI 软件与模型更新**

英伟达同步公布多项 RTX Spark 软件与模型生态更新，部分已可用、部分即将推出。

NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe 是一款新的开放权重语音模型，可用一个可提示模型完成转写、说话人标注和翻译，并支持针对音频内容提问。它支持 40 种语言，包括 7 种印度语言；开发者可用自然语言提示引导模型，例如“转写这段录音并标注每位说话人”“把这段音频翻译成英文”“列出会议中做出的决定”。提示中还可加入产品术语和格式规范，以适配医疗、金融服务、客户服务等专业词汇。由于权重开放，开发者可自行选择在桌面端或云端处理音频。该模型在 Hugging Face 开放 ASR 榜单排名第一，在 Artificial Analysis 开放权重模型榜单排名第二；活跃参数约 43 亿，比排名第一的开放权重模型少约 80%，以更少参数实现领先准确率，使高质量智能转写更适合本地硬件运行。它已在 Hugging Face 发布，量化版本即将推出，可在 RTX Spark、DGX Spark、Jetson AGX Thor 上本地运行，也可在 Blackwell 数据中心 GPU 上扩展；NVFP4 版本可通过 NeMo-Speech.cpp 或 vLLM 部署。

NVIDIA App 新增资源管理功能，允许用户在 RTX Spark 上分配 GPU 资源：可优先保障前台应用性能，也可给后台运行的智能体更多资源以更快完成任务。该功能位于 NVIDIA App 的 System > Advanced，需在 Windows 设置中启用硬件加速 GPU 调度。

Liquid AI 的 LFM3 开放模型家族获得首日支持。该家族基于共享骨干覆盖文本、视觉、音频、全模态和决策模型，基础模型与后训练模型以开放权重提供。其 17 亿参数基础模型性能超过上一代 26 亿参数基础模型，支持本地智能体工作流，例如在 Hermes Agent、Pi 和 OpenClaw 中分拣收件箱、管理日历、读取文档和应用屏幕、转写和翻译语音、回答关于手写数学的口头问题，以及路由支持工单或语音请求。开发者可通过 llama.cpp 和 vLLM 在 RTX Spark 上原生运行 LFM3，并在本地微调。

**游戏与 RTX Remix**

S-GAME 的《影之刃零》于 10 月 28 日晚 7 点（太平洋时间）登陆 Steam 和 Epic Games Store。玩家扮演被诬陷杀害师父的剑客“魂”，在武侠世界中揭开阴谋。NVIDIA 与 S-GAME 工作室及发行团队合作，为游戏加入光线追踪效果，带来更准确的反弹光照、细致反射以及植被和地形上的真实阴影。DLSS 动态多帧生成最高支持 6 倍帧生成，并可动态调整倍率以命中玩家目标帧率。

RTX Remix 1.6 上周发布，把这一用于经典游戏重制的模改平台带到《我的世界》。创作者和玩家可通过 RTX Remix 渲染《我的世界》Java 版 1.21.1，并使用 DLSS 加速的路径追踪，获得真实光照和材质。该更新还加入 DLSS 5 与 3D 引导神经渲染、最高 6 倍多帧生成、原生 RTX Spark 支持以及智能体辅助工作流。即日起，《Portal with RTX》和《半衰期 2 RTX》演示也获得这些升级，二者均支持 RTX Spark，并加入 DLSS 3D 引导神经渲染、用于 DLSS 帧生成的性能模式以及加速路径追踪的新选项。RTX Remix 1.6 还简化 AI 模改：重新设计的 ComfyUI 工作流让模改者直接在 RTX Remix 内生成基于物理的材质，无需配置 API，支持完整项目批处理和面向非技术创作者的预设；兼容的 AI 智能体还可通过 NVIDIA 智能体技能直接与 RTX Remix 协作，加速重制项目。

**其他本地 AI 生态更新**

在 GTC 柏林主题演讲中，英伟达创始人兼 CEO 黄仁勋展示了 RTX Spark 上运行的 AI 智能体如何帮助训练 Hugging Face 的 Microduck 机器人。工作流包括：Hermes Agent 和 Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 在 RTX Spark 上规划障碍路线，Astra 构建 3D 资产，NVIDIA Isaac Lab 训练导航策略，RTX Spark 在 Isaac Sim 中验证。

Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB 现已可用，仅需 4GB 内存即可支持自然对话和多步智能体任务，可在 RTX Spark、DGX Spark、GeForce RTX GPU 和 NVIDIA Jetson 设备上驱动本地语音助手、游戏角色和嵌入式界面；支持 llama.cpp、vLLM、Ollama、Unsloth 和 LM Studio，并可与 Hermes、OpenClaw 配合。面向更高要求的智能体负载，Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB 设计用于在 RTX Spark 上运行本地智能体。

Black Forest Labs 的 FLUX 3 Image Klein 是 56 亿参数开放权重模型，支持本地生成和编辑图像。NVIDIA 优化版本可在最低 8GB 显存的 RTX GPU 上运行；开发者还可用 NVIDIA NeMo AutoModel 配方在 RTX Spark 上微调，以适配特定创作流程。

NVIDIA DGX Spark 64GB 现已可从制造商伙伴购买，搭载 GB10 Grace Blackwell 超级芯片，结合 64GB 统一内存、DGX OS 和 NVIDIA AI 软件栈，用于智能体开发、推理和微调。

整体来看，RTX Spark 把原本依赖桌面工作站或云端的高性能 AI 与图形工作负载进一步推向轻薄笔记本。统一内存和 CUDA 生态是其核心差异点，开放权重模型和本地智能体功能则强化了隐私、低延迟和离线可用性。其 2599 美元起售价和 128GB 配置表明，该产品首先面向高端专业用户和重度创作者、开发者及玩家，而非大众入门市场。
