history.content: A subsidiary of Elon Musk’s xAI is offering to buy up homes in a Mississippi neighborhood, as long as residents don’t join a lawsuit targeting the company’s nearby data center and power plant, according to a report from The Guardian. A realtor going door-to-door in the Southaven neighborhood reportedly told one resident that xAI plans to purchase 418 homes, adding that 18 homeowners already have plans to sell. People who rent homes in the area report they’re already being forced out, with 60 days’ notice after their landlords agreed to sell.A recent report from the Mississippi Free Press includes a letter received by several households recently, reading in part:MZX denies all of the allegations against it. However, because MZX also requires property for its business purposes, MZX, through its real estate broker, is offering to purchase real estate in Southaven in exchange for, among other things, a release of all claims related to the lawsuit. If you decide to accept MZX’s offer, MZX will ask you to sign a real estate contract under which you will agree to execute a separate release agreement at the closing of the real estate transaction.Importantly, by executing the Release Agreement, you will be releasing possible claims you might have related to the Southaven Plant, including any claims you may have in connection with the Haley action. After executing the Release Agreement, you will be unable to recover any damages or other relief from the Haley lawsuit, and you will also be unable to bring claims on your own behalf. The Release Agreement provides further details on which claims would be released.As reported by The Guardian, xAI offered to purchase the homes if the owners don’t join a lawsuit filed by three residents, who accuse the company’s massive data center and gas-fired turbines of emitting “near-constant noise” and vibrations. xAI has ramped up its data center buildout over the past couple of years, constructing two sprawling “Colossus” facilities in Memphis, while bringing its “Macrohardrr” data center and an accompanying power plant to Southaven, which is located just over the Tennessee border.Growing opposition to AI data centers is putting pressure on politicians in the weeks leading up to the midterm elections. Last week, Memphis City Council voted down a one-year moratorium on AI data center development, and instead adopted an ordinance that would pause construction for 135 days. After Mississippi’s governor touted the company’s plan to invest more than $20 billion in the area earlier this year, SpaceXAI recently reported it’s facing up to $6.1 million in potential civil penalties for environmental law violations, along with more than $220 million in claims of unpaid bills for work performed at the Memphis and Southaven sites.In addition to a lawsuit filed by residents, xAI is also facing legal action from the National Association for the Advancement of Colored People (NAACP), which accuses the company of operating dozens of unpermitted methane gas turbines in Southaven. A federal judge blocked the Trump administration’s attempt to dismiss the lawsuit earlier this month.

history.titleZh: xAI正买断承诺不就数据中心噪音起诉的房主
history.descriptionZh:
据《卫报》报道，埃隆·马斯克旗下xAI的一家子公司正提出购买美国密西西比州Southaven社区的多套住宅，条件是房主不加入针对该公司附近数据中心和电厂的一场诉讼。报道称，一名房地产经纪人逐户通知居民，xAI计划购买418套住宅，并称已有18名房主计划出售。当地租户则表示，在房东同意出售后，他们已被要求60天内搬离。

《密西西比自由新闻》获得的信件显示，xAI子公司MZX在信中否认所有针对它的指控，但表示公司因业务需要房产，因此通过房地产经纪商提出购买Southaven的房地产，交换条件包括放弃与诉讼相关的全部索赔。若居民接受报价，需签署房地产合同，并在交易交割时另行签署释放协议。该协议将使其放弃与Southaven电厂相关的潜在索赔，包括与Haley诉讼有关的索赔；签署后，居民将无法从Haley诉讼中获得损害赔偿或其他救济，也不能自行提起诉讼。

《卫报》称，xAI提出购房的条件是业主不加入三名居民提起的诉讼。该诉讼指控xAI的大型数据中心和燃气轮机产生“近乎持续不断的噪音”和振动。过去几年，xAI加速数据中心建设，在孟菲斯建设了两座大型“Colossus”设施，并将“Macrohardrr”数据中心及配套电厂带到位于田纳西州边界另一侧的Southaven。从技术上看，这类AI数据中心通常由大规模GPU集群组成，用于训练和运行大模型，功耗和散热需求极高；xAI通过自建燃气轮机电厂进行现场供电，可缩短接入电网的时间、支撑快速扩张，但也带来排放、噪音、振动和许可合规等争议。其创新点更多体现在算力基础设施与能源供应的垂直整合和快速部署，而非单一芯片技术。

报道指出，针对AI数据中心的反对声正在中期选举前给政客带来压力。上周，孟菲斯市议会否决了为期一年的AI数据中心开发暂停令，转而通过一项暂停建设135天的条例。密西西比州州长今年早些时候曾宣传该公司计划在该地区投资超过200亿美元；但SpaceXAI最近报告称，公司面临最高610万美元的环境违法潜在民事罚款，以及孟菲斯和Southaven工地已完成工作超过2.2亿美元的未付账单索赔。

除居民诉讼外，xAI还面临美国全国有色人种协进会（NAACP）的法律行动。NAACP指控该公司在Southaven运营数十台未获许可的甲烷燃气轮机。本月早些时候，一名联邦法官阻止了特朗普政府试图驳回该诉讼的努力。整体来看，此案凸显AI数据中心快速扩张中的土地、能源、环境合规和社区关系风险：企业以购房换取撤诉的做法引发道德和法律争议，而地方政治、环境诉讼和财务索赔可能影响其超大规模算力基础设施的推进。

history.title: Standalone Nvidia Vera CPUs land in Oracle Cloud's multi-gigawatt deployment
history.description: Nvidia’s Vera CPU is now generally available on Oracle’s OCI Superclusters, a win for Nvidia as it moves past NVL72 to a standalone Vera deployment at a major hyperscaler.
history.content: Share Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Nvidia and Oracle have announced general availability of Nvidia’s Vera Rubin NVL72 rack and Vera CPUs on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Superclusters at Oracle AI World on Tuesday. The announcement comes hot on the heels of Google Cloud announcing general availability for Vera Rubin last week, putting two major hyperscaler feathers in Nvidia’s cap. However, Oracle’s announcement is interesting, specifically calling out standalone Vera instances on OCI Superclusters. We've included a few benchmarks we've performed on a Vera server for a forthcoming review to highlight some of the chip's performance characteristics, but do note that these tests were not conducted on OCI infrastructure.Neoclouds have been banging the drum of Vera for the past several weeks, with instances under way at Nscale, CoreWeave, and Nebius, among others, so it makes sense to see Vera in the GPU-dominant and AI-focused neoclouds. A standalone deployment at a hyperscaler like Oracle sends a different signal, however.Although hyperscalers maintain large fleets of hardware, sometimes even renting from the neoclouds, the CPU focus is primarily on x86, with OCI Superclusters otherwise offering the Ampere Altra for an Arm-based instance. It’s Nvidia’s first standalone CPU push into the hyperscale data center, placing Vera alongside the x86 competition regardless of the GPU compute.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Vera is not meant to upend the x86 guard, at least in isolation. Ian Buck, Nvidia’s mind behind CUDA and the face of Nvidia’s AI infrastructure buildout, said in March — when the chip was revealed — that the world couldn’t be served by a single, 88-core SKU. However, Vera is opening the door at hyperscalers like Oracle to expand in future CPU generations.AMD and Intel maintain the lead when it comes to single-socket density, which is only set to expand in the next generation, as AMD’s upcoming EPYC Venice CPUs can pack up to 512 threads in a single socket. However, Vera offers some distinct advantages due to its topology depending on the workload, many of which are becoming increasingly relevant in the agentic AI era. You may like Modal taps Nvidia Vera CPUs after firm's internal tests show 2x throughput over Intel and AMD chips Hot Chips 2026: Nvidia breaks down 88-core Vera CPU SpaceXAI will deploy standalone Nvidia Vera CPUs for Grok's agentic workloads Memory bandwidth, for instance, is one of Vera’s strong suits, and that’s not just a marketing claim. Nvidia has said the memory system is capable of 1.2 TB/s of bandwidth, but we can see Nvidia’s lead outside of theoretical numbers in our testing below. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)Take the industry-standard Stream benchmark as an example. Nvidia’s use of LPDDR5X-9600, along with a monolithic die and distributed mesh for caching, allows it to more than double the bandwidth available on a dual Intel Xeon 6980P system, even when it’s paired with MRDIMMs sporting speeds of 8,800 MT/s. We’re showing triad here, as it’s the most “demanding” of Stream’s operations, but the leads for Vera are similar across add, copy, and scale as well.This bandwidth is critical for some types of agentic loops, particularly those dealing with large database queries or extensive documentation. You can see the OpenMP “spread” policy offers a massive boost to Vera’s memory bandwidth, as well. Both AMD and Intel maintain centralized memory control and system-level cache, while Vera distributes it in a mesh across the die. The result, at least in OpenMP set properly, is much higher memory bandwidth by binding processes as far away from each other as possible.Another critical performance vector for agentic AI is Python. The agentic world is expanding, but much of the foundation of the AI software ecosystem is built on Python. Common agentic frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph are written in Python, and although we’re seeing more frameworks built in languages like Rust and TypeScript, Python performance is still critical to agentic loops. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)And, unsurprisingly, it’s an area where Vera is also strong, beating out CPUs that are much more powerful on paper. Popular agentic harnesses are built on Python, but so are many of the applications that also run on Python, including foundational AI libraries like PyTorch and TensorFlow. What to read next OpenAI’s Jalapeño ASICs are deployed alongside AMD EPYC ‘Turin’ CPUs as hosts, not Nvidia's Vera AMD targets Nvidia with first official benchmarks for EPYC 'Venice' CPUs Nvidia expects to sell $20 billion worth of Vera Rubin hardware this quarter Nvidia’s focus on agentic AI makes sense given the times we’re living in, but it can miss the forest for the trees. Oracle bringing Vera standalone instances online shifts the focus onto the broader implications of Vera’s entrance into the data center. There are some aspects of performance that characterize agentic AI workloads, but many agent workloads are regular data center workloads in the first place, just under high concurrency. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)For instance, SQLite performance is important for any server querying a large database, regardless of its written by logic, a person, or an AI agent. Nvidia’s second-gen Scalable Coherency Fabric (SCF), which we saw at play in Stream, shows up in a real workload here, with these database queries largely bound by data movement across the system.And that is what makes Vera so interesting in the context of Oracle’s announcement. It’s a CPU built for agentic AI, says Nvidia, but the crosstalk with general data center workloads is strong. It’s not just a CPU to use because you need access to Nvidia’s accelerators. Depending on the workload, it may even be a better choice than the x86 guard.Ultimately, we have to see how customers of these hyperscalers use (or don’t use) Vera in production. It’s demonstrated its usefulness in agentic AI loops, but it’s also showing early promise in certain general-purpose workloads. Oracle’s standalone deployment is a sign that there’s some demand for Vera that isn't exclusively tied at the hip of a Rubin GPU.Oracle is approaching cautiously, however, as any hyperscaler should be when bringing up a multi-gigawatt deployment. The company said it will also offer Nvidia’s HGX NVL8, bringing eight Rubin GPUs together in a cluster, connected to a dual, 64-core Intel Xeon 6 host with 4TB of DDR5 memory.Our testing of Vera shared in this article is part of a larger benchmarking session we had with the chip, and we'll share the technical details of the test setup in our forthcoming review. We’ll be publishing our full results shortly on Tom’s Hardware.

history.descriptionZh:
Nvidia与Oracle在Oracle AI World上宣布，Nvidia的Vera Rubin NVL72机架和Vera CPU已在Oracle Cloud Infrastructure（OCI）Superclusters上正式可用。此前一周，Google Cloud刚宣布Vera Rubin正式可用，使Nvidia接连拿下两家主要超大规模云厂商。Oracle此次公告的特别之处在于，它明确提供独立的Vera实例，而不仅是与Rubin GPU捆绑的部署。这意味着Nvidia首次将独立CPU推向超大规模数据中心，使Vera在不依赖GPU计算的情况下直接与x86阵营竞争。不过，Nvidia并不认为Vera会单独颠覆x86的主导地位。CUDA负责人Ian Buck曾表示，世界不可能只靠一个88核SKU来服务；但Vera为Oracle等超大规模客户未来扩展CPU产品代际打开了大门。

从技术上看，Vera的关键优势之一是内存带宽和拓扑设计。Nvidia称其内存系统带宽可达1.2 TB/s。在行业标准Stream基准测试中，Vera采用LPDDR5X-9600、单片式die和分布式mesh缓存，其Triad测试带宽超过双路Intel Xeon 6980P系统两倍以上，即使后者搭配8,800 MT/s的MRDIMM。AMD和Intel采用集中式内存控制和系统级缓存，而Vera在die上以mesh方式分布内存与缓存；在正确设置OpenMP的“spread”策略、将进程尽量分散绑定后，Vera可获得显著更高的内存带宽。这一特性对处理大型数据库查询或大量文档的agentic循环尤其重要。另一个关键性能维度是Python。CrewAI、LangGraph等主流agent框架以及PyTorch、TensorFlow等AI基础库都大量依赖Python，Vera在这一领域也表现强劲，甚至能击败纸面规格更强的CPU。作者同时强调，文中展示的Vera服务器基准测试并非在OCI基础设施上运行，而是其后续完整评测的一部分。

新闻进一步指出，Nvidia强调Vera面向agentic AI，但许多agent工作负载本质上仍是高并发的常规数据中心工作负载。例如SQLite数据库查询性能对所有查询大型数据库的服务器都很重要，无论查询逻辑由人还是AI agent编写。Vera的第二代Scalable Coherency Fabric（SCF）在Stream测试中已有体现，在真实数据库查询中也发挥作用，因为这类查询很大程度上受系统内数据移动限制。因此，Vera不仅是“需要访问Nvidia加速器时才用的CPU”，在部分通用负载中甚至可能比x86方案更合适。Oracle的独立部署表明，市场对Vera存在不完全依附于Rubin GPU的需求。但Oracle也保持谨慎：它还将提供Nvidia HGX NVL8，将八颗Rubin GPU组成集群，并连接双路64核Intel Xeon 6主机和4TB DDR5内存。最终，Vera在超大规模生产环境中的实际采用情况仍有待观察；它已在agentic AI循环中展示价值，并在某些通用工作负载上显露早期潜力。

The company is selling a 300-rack AI supercomputer on eBay for $59.7 million, complete with $50 overnight shipping, or free shipping if you're willing to go with FedEx Ground. The cluster packs 9,600 Nvidia A100 accelerators and 4,200 AMD EPYC Rome 64-core processors, enough to jump-start your own sovereign AI nation.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)The data center cooling state of playThe custom AI ASIC state of play America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the priceGTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this yearDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsibleNvidia and AMD have moved to newer architectures like Blackwell, Vera Rubin, and EPYC Turin. Nonetheless, A100 (codenamed Ampere) accelerators and EPYC Rome processors remain highly relevant for many computing tasks, including AI, machine learning, and scientific research. With the modern Blackwell and Vera Rubin racks from Nvidia, like the GB300 NVL72 and VR200 NVL72, costing up to $6.5 million and $7.8 million per unit, respectively, the A100 has turned into a legitimate budget alternative that can also circumvent the long waitlists and supply chain delays on Nvidia's newer AI hardware.The cluster's sheer specifications are truly jaw-dropping. Each rack has four compute nodes and three management nodes. Each compute node has two AMD EPYC Rome 64-core processors, eight Nvidia A100 40GB SXM4 accelerators, and 1TB of DDR4-2933 memory. The management nodes are no less impressive. Each features two EPYC 64-core chips and 192GB of DDR4 memory.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: When you sum it all up, the cluster comprises up to 9,600 A100 accelerators and 4,200 AMD EPYC Rome processors. A rough estimate would be about $24 million for the A100S, $3 million for the EPYC Rome chips, and about $1.1 million for the DDR4 memory. That is about $28.1 million in crucial components, before factoring in other hardware like racks, cooling, power supplies, Nvidia Mellanox ConnectX-6 SmartNICs, etc. You may like Nvidia’s GB300-powered DGX Station desktop tower listed for nearly $100,000 online Reddit user pays $35 for a crypto mining rig left in a garage and gets 54GB of VRAM at 65 cents per GB CoreWeave proves Nvidia's aging AI GPUs from 2020 can generate profit nine years after deployment, signs A100 contracts into 2029 Listing a 300-rack supercomputing cluster on eBay sounds absurd, but given today's AI-driven world, it is not as surprising as it may seem. As AI farms and data centers expand, some enterprise clients out there will recognize the value and opportunity in the listing.Shipping that many racks will be a logistics nightmare, and as funny as it sounds, Core 4 Solutions offers free local pickup or FedEx Ground delivery directly to your home. There is even an option to pay for a $25 two-day or $50 overnight delivery. history.titleZh: IT供应商在eBay挂牌出售价值6000万美元的大型AI超级计算机，包含300机架退役GPU
history.descriptionZh:
Core 4 Solutions 正在 eBay 上以 5970 万美元挂牌出售一套 300 机柜的 AI 超级计算机集群，并开出 50 美元隔夜达、25 美元两日达、FedEx Ground 免费配送以及本地自提等物流选项。文章戏称，这套系统足以“启动一个主权 AI 国家”，也反映出高端 AI 算力正在成为一种可在公开平台上交易的特殊资产。

这套集群的核心配置包括 9600 块 Nvidia A100 40GB SXM4 加速器和 4200 颗 AMD EPYC Rome 64 核处理器，总计 268,800 个 CPU 核心，内存容量最高约 1,401.6TB，也就是约 1.4PB DDR4。每个机柜包含 4 个计算节点和 3 个管理节点；每个计算节点配备 2 颗 EPYC Rome 64 核处理器、8 块 A100 40GB SXM4 和 1TB DDR4-2933 内存；每个管理节点则配备 2 颗 EPYC 64 核处理器和 192GB DDR4 内存。文章按关键部件粗略估算，A100 约值 2400 万美元，EPYC Rome 处理器约 300 万美元，DDR4 内存约 110 万美元，合计约 2810 万美元，尚未计入机柜、冷却、电源以及 Nvidia Mellanox ConnectX-6 SmartNIC 等系统级硬件成本。

从技术代际看，A100 属于 Nvidia Ampere 架构，EPYC Rome 属于 AMD Zen 2 架构，均已不是最新产品；但它们在 AI、机器学习和科学研究等任务中仍具实用性。文章对比称，Nvidia 新一代 Blackwell 和 Vera Rubin 机柜系统，如 GB300 NVL72 和 VR200 NVL72，单套价格可高达 650 万美元和 780 万美元，且面临较长等待名单和供应链延迟。因此，A100 集群被视为一种“预算型替代方案”，可帮助需要成熟算力的客户绕开新品交付瓶颈。不过，新旧平台在单卡性能、能效和架构上差异明显，不能简单按机柜单价线性比较。

这笔交易的技术看点不在于新架构突破，而在于将大规模存量高端 AI 算力整体打包流通。此类集群适合 AI 训练与推理、机器学习、科学计算、HPC 以及主权 AI、云服务商和研究机构等场景，但 300 个机柜的部署需要大型机房、电力、冷却和高速网络支撑，并非普通用户可在家中运行。文章提到，该 eBay 列表已有 11 人关注、1 人将其加入购物车；无论最终是否成交，它都凸显了 AI 基础设施需求旺盛、A100 等旧代高端 GPU 仍具经济价值，以及二手/存量算力市场正在升温的趋势。
